title.en: Ed Sheeran rarely talks politics. The Macklemore controversy has put him at the centre of it
title.zh: 埃德·希兰很少谈论政治。麦克尔莫尔的争议使他处于中心

summary.en: As artists quit Ed Sheeran's tour in solidarity with Macklemore, a wider debate is unfolding.
summary.zh: 随着艺术家们退出了埃德·希兰的巡演以声援麦克尔莫尔，一场更广泛的辩论正在展开。

body.en:
Ed Sheeran has built one of the world's biggest music careers while largely avoiding one of the more divisive parts of modern celebrity: politics.

The English singer has spoken publicly about some causes over the years, including performing at a major benefit concert for Ukraine following Russia's 2022 invasion. But he has generally resisted using his concerts as a political platform, something he says is deliberate.

Now, Macklemore's removal from his United States tour has drawn Sheeran into a political debate he has largely sought to avoid.

In less than two weeks, Macklemore has made a high-profile pro-Palestinian speech while opening for Sheeran, been removed from his remaining US tour dates, and been followed out the door by four other acts.

Sheeran has insisted the decision to remove the American rapper wasn't his and says he spent days trying to prevent it.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But the fallout has nevertheless dragged the 35-year-old singer into a highly charged debate over the Israel-Gaza conflict, antisemitism and the role, or responsibility, of artists to use their platforms to take a political stand.

And it has forced Sheeran to publicly explain why, unlike Macklemore, he generally chooses not to.

"I have my personal views on this devastating conflict," Sheeran wrote in a lengthy statement posted to Instagram this week.

"Just because I choose not to speak publicly, it doesn't mean I don't have them, and it doesn't mean I don't care."

The dispute began on 4 September, when Macklemore was performing as a support act on Sheeran's Loop Tour at a New Jersey stadium.

Introducing his 2024 protest song Hind's Hall, the rapper told the crowd that part of the reason he wanted to join the tour was to use its enormous stadium audiences to amplify his support for Palestinians.

"A big part of the reason why I wanted to do this tour in the first place is so I could stand up in stadiums like this and say two words that are very near and dear to my heart: 'Free Palestine'," Macklemore said.

The following day, he again addressed the conflict, telling Jewish members of the audience that his criticism of Israel was not criticism of them.

The remarks sparked a backlash, with the Israeli-American Council launching a petition calling for Macklemore to be removed from the tour, arguing Sheeran's stage should not be used for "one-sided political propaganda".

By Monday, he was off the tour. Promoter Messina Touring Group said venue owners hosting upcoming dates had indicated they would not allow shows featuring Macklemore to proceed.

The episode has highlighted the starkly different approaches the two artists take to their public...
body.zh: 艾德·希兰 (Ed Sheeran) 建立了世界上最大的音乐事业之一，同时在很大程度上避开了现代名人中最具争议性的部分之一：政治。 这位英国歌手多年来曾公开谈论过一些原因，包括在俄罗斯 2022 年入侵后为乌克兰举办的一场大型慈善音乐会上表演。但他总体上拒绝将音乐会作为政治平台，他说这是故意的。 现在，麦克莫尔被取消美国之行，这让希兰陷入了一场他在很大程度上试图避免的政治辩论。 在不到两周的时间里，麦克莫尔在为希兰开场时发表了高调的亲巴勒斯坦演讲，被从他剩余的美国巡演日期中删除，并被其他四位表演者追随出局。 希兰坚称，解雇这位美国说唱歌手的决定不是他自己做出的，并表示他花了几天时间试图阻止这一决定。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但此事的后果却让这位 35 岁的歌手卷入了一场关于以色列-加沙冲突、反犹太主义以及艺术家利用自己的平台表明政治立场的角色或责任的激烈辩论。 这迫使希兰公开解释为什么与麦克莫尔不同，他通常选择不这样做。 “我对这场毁灭性的冲突有我个人的看法，”希兰在本周发布在 Instagram 上的一份长篇声明中写道。 “仅仅因为我选择不公开发言，并不意味着我没有它们，也不意味着我不在乎。” 这场纠纷始于 9 月 4 日，当时 Macklemore 在新泽西州体育场为 Sheeran's Loop Tour 表演助兴表演。 这位说唱歌手在介绍他的 2024 年抗议歌曲《Hind's Hall》时告诉观众，他想参加巡演的部分原因是利用体育场庞大的观众来扩大他对巴勒斯坦人的支持。 麦克勒莫尔说：“我最初想要参加这次巡演的一个重要原因是，我可以站在这样的体育场里，说出两个我心目中非常亲近的词：‘自由巴勒斯坦’。” 第二天，他再次谈到了这场冲突，告诉观众中的犹太成员，他对以色列的批评并不是对他们的批评。 这一言论引发了强烈反对，以色列-美国委员会发起请愿书，要求将麦克勒莫从巡演中除名，并认为希兰的舞台不应被用于“单方面的政治宣传”。 到了周一，他就退出了巡演。发起人 Messina Touring Group 表示，举办即将举行的演出的场地所有者已表示，他们不会允许麦克莫尔的演出继续进行。 这一集凸显了两位艺术家对公众采取的截然不同的方式......

reflection.en: Ed Sheeran has built a career on largely avoiding political statements, a deliberate choice to sidestep divisive issues. However, the controversy surrounding Macklemore's pro-Palestinian speech has unexpectedly placed Sheeran at the center of a political debate he sought to avoid. This situation highlights how even attempts to remain neutral can draw...
reflection.zh: 埃德·希兰的职业生涯很大程度上建立在避免政治表态之上，这是他刻意选择避开争议性问题的做法。然而，围绕麦克尔莫尔亲巴勒斯坦演讲的争议却出人意料地将希兰置于他试图回避的政治辩论的中心。这种情况凸显了即使是试图保持中立，也可能将个人卷入公众的争论之中，尤其是在个人信念与公众平台交织在一起时。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

Yet, Psalm 46:9 offers a profound reminder that ultimate resolution belongs to Yahweh, who stills the earth and ends wars. Even symbolic political actions point to a deeper human longing for cessation of hostilities, a...
reflection.zh: 面对持续不断的全球冲突，例如伊朗正在发生的局势，可能会让人觉得和平遥不可及。然而，诗篇 46:9 提供了深刻的提醒，最终的解决归于雅伟，祂使地停止争战，止息刀兵。即使是象征性的政治行动，也指向了人类对停止敌对行动的深切渴望，这种渴望在神圣的干预中得到最终的实现。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: ‘Pretend I’m on the ticket’: Trump hits campaign trail in bid to boost Republican hopes

Despite Trump’s deep unpopularity, Republicans hope to once again turn the president’s loyal following into a political force as the party confronts an unforgiving midterm landscape. This framing can obscure the deeper spiritual dynamics at play, turning human disagreements into perceived battles against evil forces. The call to "crush" suggests a desire for total annihilation, which can blind us to the need for...

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: Fiji declares national HIV emergency as Pacific nation grapples with surge in cases
title.zh: 斐济宣布国家艾滋病紧急状态，太平洋岛国应对病例激增

summary.en: Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency due to a significant increase in cases, with estimates suggesting one in 60 adults are now living with HIV. Health officials attribute the surge partly to the escalating use of methamphetamine, prompting an outbreak-level response.
summary.zh: 斐济因病例显著增加而宣布国家进入艾滋病紧急状态，估计目前每60名成年人中就有1名感染艾滋病毒。卫生官员将疫情激增部分归因于冰毒使用的加剧，促使国家采取疫情爆发级别的应对措施。

body.en: Government estimates that one in 60 adults in Fiji now living with HIV, as escalating use of methamphetamine fuels ‘epidemic’ Fiji has declared a national HIV emergency amid a spike in infections as the Pacific nation grapples with a correlating rise in methamphetamine use. The country’s health and medical services minister, Dr Ratu Atonio Lalabalavu, said in a statement on social media that an outbreak-level response was no longer sufficient to address what he described an “epidemic”. body.zh: 政府估计，斐济每 60 名成年人中就有 1 人感染艾滋病毒，因为甲基苯丙胺的使用不断增加，加剧了“流行病” 斐济已宣布全国艾滋病毒紧急状态，因为感染人数激增，这个太平洋国家正在努力应对甲基苯丙胺使用量的相关增加。该国卫生和医疗服务部长拉图·阿托尼奥·拉拉巴拉武博士在社交媒体上发表声明称，疫情级别的应对措施已不足以应对他所说的“流行病”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news from Fiji is sobering, revealing a nation grappling with a serious health crisis and the complex factors contributing to it. In times of widespread illness and epidemic, the call to pray for the sick, as found in James 5:14, offers a pastoral response. It reminds us to extend compassion and hope to those affected, trusting in Yahweh's healing power.
reflection.zh: 来自斐济的消息令人警醒，揭示了一个国家正艰难应对严重的健康危机及其复杂的诱因。在疾病和疫情蔓延之时，《雅各书》5章14节呼吁为病人祷告，这提供了一种牧养的回应。它提醒我们向受影响者伸出同情和希望之手，并信靠雅伟的医治大能。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Why this tiny English village voted to 'secede' from the UK
title.zh: 为何这个微小的英国村庄投票“脱离”英国

summary.en: Residents of a small English village have voted to leave the UK in a symbolic independence referendum, protesting plans to house over 1,200 migrants in a nearby facility.
summary.zh: 英国一个小村庄的居民在一场象征性的独立公投中投票决定脱离英国，以抗议在附近设施安置超过1200名移民的计划。

body.en:
An English village of around 350 people announced overnight that a vast majority of residents had voted to exit the United Kingdom in an "independence referendum" in protest at plans to house over 1,200 migrants in a nearby facility.

Piddington in central England, 25 kilometres from the university city of Oxford, has grabbed headlines with its tongue-in-cheek breakaway vote.

The village's parish council announced that with 312 ballots counted, 285 had voted to secede from Britain over plans to house asylum seekers in a nearby disused military site, in a symbolic vote with no recognised legal basis.

Residents were handed a ballot paper with the statement: "I support Piddington seeking to secede from the United Kingdom and pursuing self-determination."

The local parish council chair Tim McNally said that the village will now be known as the "principality of Piddington".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

McNally told UK broadcaster Sky News: "For us, it's about proportionality — how does a small village of 350 odd people assimilate with 1,250 males?"

The leader of Oxfordshire county council Tim Bearder, speaking to the BBC, warned the planned centre "will be a lightning rod to the far right, who come here to protest" and "potentially attack" asylum seekers.

Prime Minister Andy Burnham promised to "look at the issues raised by the community and in the referendum" but said the "vast majority" of British people backed a government plan to stop housing asylum seekers in hotels and it was "fair" to locate holding centres around the country.

UK culture secretary Lisa Nandy told the BBC a former military base "is a better option for housing asylum seekers" than hotels or rented accommodation and vowed the base would go ahead.

Around Britain, regular protests have been staged against housing asylum seekers in hotels and other facilities.

Supporters called the declaration of independence a victory for people power and local democracy. Some media coverage compared the gesture to the comedy film Passport to Pimlico.

In the 1949 classic, a small group of Londoners discover treasure and declare independence making them exempt from post-war rationing and other bureaucratic restrictions.

Others said the campaign had a darker side and stirred up fear of newcomers. Some backers of the Piddington referendum compared their fight against the asylum accommodation to the 1940 Battle of Britain against Nazi Germany.

Villager Herbert Owen, 76, said after voting that the independence referendum "isn’t just about Piddington," adding: "It means everything our grandparents, our parents fought for. Today is the Battle of Britain."

title.en: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
title.zh: 美联储三年首次加息

summary.en: The US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time in over three years, a unanimous decision made to combat rising prices, despite opposition from President Donald Trump who had advocated for a rate cut.
summary.zh: 美国联邦储备委员会三年多来首次提高利率，这一一致决定旨在遏制物价上涨，尽管总统唐纳德·特朗普曾主张降息。

body.en:
US interest rates have been raised for the first time in more than three years and could be increased further in a bid to slow rising prices.

Rates were hiked to 3.75%-4% from 3.5%-3.75% by the Federal Reserve in a unanimous decision, despite fierce opposition from President Donald Trump, who had called for rates to be cut.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said the move was because "inflation is too high and has been for too long", adding that it was a "sober" and "responsible decision".

After the announcement, Trump expressed support for Warsh but said the Fed board, which votes on rate decisions, was "hostile".

Higher interest rates make borrowing more expensive for people wanting to secure loans, mortgages, and credit cards, but can lead to better returns on savings.

Warsh said during a press conference on Wednesday following the decision that, while there was "an attitude of optimism" within the Fed leadership, inflation remained a problem.

Like many central banks, the Fed has a target of keeping inflation at 2% or below. Warsh noted that US inflation has been above the target "for more than five years".

That has helped make affordability one of the top concerns of American voters, who have seen fuel prices surge in response to soaring wholesale oil prices since the start of the US-Israel war with Iran. This has driven up the cost of many goods and services, as well.

While the Fed "cannot affect any individual price – whether it be oil prices, whether it be food stuffs at the grocery store", Warsh said, the central bank can work to keep price rises from broadening across the economy.

He added that strength in the jobs market and wider economy meant the Fed was staying focused on stabilising prices, and that those least well off had the most to gain from lower inflation.

Central banks tend to increase rates when inflation is high to discourage spending and encourage saving, in the hope this will reduce the pace of price rises. But it's a balancing act, as higher rates can also encourage businesses to hold off on investing and hurt economic growth.

When he was confirmed, Democratic lawmakers had said Warsh would be Trump's "sock puppet" and many Fed watchers expected him to carry out Trump's persistent demands to slash rates. Trump had been heavily critical of Warsh's predecessor Jerome Powell for not cutting them.

Asked on Wednesday about the message the rate hike sent to Trump, Warsh chuckled before saying: "I have got nothing for you on a discussion with the president."

Trump told reporters later "I'm relying on Kevin [Warsh], but he's got, you know, a very tough board".

"And the, interest rates are too high. They're not appropriate... I talked to Kevin and I said, 'you might as well vote with the board because it's not going to matter.' The...
body.zh: 美国三年多来首次加息，并可能进一步加息，以减缓物价上涨。 尽管美国总统特朗普强烈反对降息，但美联储还是一致决定将利率从 3.5%-3.75% 上调至 3.75%-4%。 美联储主席凯文·沃什表示，此举是因为“通胀过高且持续时间太长”，并补充说这是一个“清醒”且“负责任的决定”。 然而，特朗普表示，利率“应该为 1% 或更低，因为我们是迄今为止世界上最好的信贷机构”。 对于想要获得贷款、抵押贷款和信用卡的人来说，较高的利率使借贷成本更高，但可以带来更好的储蓄回报。 沃什在周三决定后的新闻发布会上表示，尽管美联储领导层内部存在“乐观态度”，但通胀仍然是一个问题。 与许多央行一样，美联储的目标是将通胀率保持在 2% 或以下。沃什指出，美国通胀“五年多来”一直高于目标。 这使得负担能力成为美国选民最关心的问题之一，自美以与伊朗战争爆发以来，由于批发石油价格飙升，燃料价格飙升。这也推高了许多商品和服务的成本。 沃什表示，虽然美联储“无法影响任何单独的价格——无论是油价，还是杂货店的食品价格”，但央行可以努力阻止物价上涨扩大到整个经济领域。 他补充说，就业市场和更广泛的经济的强劲意味着美联储将继续专注于稳定物价，而那些最不富裕的人将从通胀下降中受益最多。 当通胀高企时，央行往往会提高利率，以抑制支出并鼓励储蓄，希望这能减缓物价上涨的步伐。但这是一种平衡行为，因为较高的利率也会鼓励企业推迟投资并损害经济增长。 当他被任命为民主党议员时，民主党议员曾表示，沃什将成为特朗普的“傀儡”，许多美联储观察人士预计他将执行特朗普一贯的降息要求。特朗普曾严厉批评沃什的前任杰罗姆·鲍威尔没有削减预算。 周三，当被问及加息向特朗普发出的信息时，沃什笑着说：“关于与总统的讨论，我没有什么可以告诉你的。” 不久之后，特朗普在社交媒体上表示：“降低美国的利率，而且要快！” 国会山的民主党人表示，加息将使贷款成本更高，反过来，更多的美国人将陷入债务困境。 “这将使一切变得更加昂贵，”说......

This action underscores the principle that debt can create a form of bondage, as Proverbs 22:7 warns, 'the borrower is slave to the lender.' The Fed's move, described as 'sober' and...

body.en:
The president of the European Commission has backed proposals for Canada to become the EU's first "associate member".

Ursula von der Leyen told the European Parliament on Wednesday she wanted to work on "opening the door" for Canada, which would involve closer ties on various key sectors.

The country currently faces tense relations with the US, compounded by an intensifying dispute over trade.

Insisting it would not be a "partnership against anyone else", Von der Leyen did not mention Donald Trump by name. Nevertheless the US president threatened to cut trade with the European Union in response to the proposal.

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney last week spoke of seeking a "unique alliance" with the EU.

Carney was in attendance at the annual key note speech in Strasbourg, and is due to address the parliament on Thursday.

Trade talks between Canada and the US collapsed last month, sparking a series of new tariff measures . Trump's repeated talk of making Canada a "51st state" has also helped to fuel the feud between the North American neighbours.

Von der Leyen told the EU's State of the Union address that the bloc and Canada "see the world with the same eyes", including on topics ranging from AI, to climate change and geopolitics.

"And we have stood together: on Ukraine, on defence, on raw materials and on supply chains. But above all... Europe and Canada believe in democracy."

She added: "Partnerships are a strategic choice for Europe. But they also respond to the fracture in the international rules-based system".

She did not give specific details on how any Canadian membership would work, but listed manufacturing, technology, artificial intelligence (AI), defence, energy, critical minerals and economic security as key areas for cooperation.

"If they do that, if I think it's at all a hostile act, I will put very serious tariffs or stop trading with Europe, on many things."

He added: "If it's a good intention, that's fine. If it's a bad intention, we'll put very heavy tariffs on Europe, which is a possibility."

Both von der Leyen and other European leaders have found a reliable ally in Carney as they deal with similar problems.

In particular, they have faced Trump's aggressive use of tariffs and his threat to annex Greenland which is a sovereign territory of EU member Denmark.

But "associate membership" of the EU does not currently exist and the process, if agreed, could take years.

Earlier this year, Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz suggested - to a mixed reaction - that Ukraine could be granted this new status.

Some countries in the western Balkans including Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Serbia are already on the long road towards full EU membership.

body.zh: 欧盟委员会主席支持加拿大成为欧盟第一个“准成员”的提议。 乌苏拉·冯德莱恩周三向欧洲议会表示，她希望致力于为加拿大“打开大门”，这将涉及在各个关键领域建立更紧密的联系。 目前，该国与美国关系紧张，贸易争端加剧。 冯德莱恩坚称这不会是“针对其他任何人的伙伴关系”，并没有提及唐纳德·特朗普的名字。尽管如此，美国总统还是威胁要削减与欧盟的贸易以回应该提议。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼上周表示寻求与欧盟建立“独特的联盟”。 卡尼出席了在斯特拉斯堡举行的年度主题演讲，并将于周四在议会发表讲话。 加拿大和美国之间的贸易谈判上个月破裂，引发了一系列新的关税措施。特朗普一再谈论要让加拿大成为“第51个州”，这也助长了北美邻国之间的不和。 冯德莱恩在欧盟国情咨文中表示，欧盟和加拿大“以同样的眼光看待世界”，包括人工智能、气候变化和地缘政治等话题。 “我们在乌克兰、国防、原材料和供应链上都站在一起。但最重要的是……欧洲和加拿大相信民主。” 她补充道：“伙伴关系是欧洲的战略选择。但它们也是对国际规则体系破裂的回应”。 她没有透露加拿大成员资格如何运作的具体细节，但将制造、技术、人工智能（AI）、国防、能源、关键矿产和经济安全列为重点合作领域。 “如果他们这样做，如果我认为这完全是一种敌对行为，我将在很多事情上征收非常严厉的关税或停止与欧洲的贸易。” 他补充道：“如果是善意，那就好。如果是恶意，我们将对欧洲征收非常高的关税，这是有可能的。” 冯德莱恩和其他欧洲领导人在处理类似问题时都在卡尼身上找到了可靠的盟友。 特别是，他们面临特朗普激进地使用关税以及威胁吞并欧盟成员国丹麦的主权领土格陵兰岛。 但欧盟的“准成员资格”目前并不存在，如果达成一致，这一过程可能需要数年时间。 今年早些时候，德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨建议乌克兰可以获得这一新地位，反应不一。 巴尔干西部的一些国家，包括阿尔巴尼亚、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那、黑山、北马其顿和塞尔维亚，已经踏上了成为欧盟正式成员的漫长道路。 该集团 27 个成员国中有 10 个尚未...

title.en: Snapchat 'willing to implement' daily time limits for teens, boss tells BBC
title.zh: Snapchat 称愿为青少年实施每日限时

summary.en: Snap Inc. CEO Evan Spiegel stated in a BBC interview that the company would be open to implementing daily time limits for teenage users, calling it a potential "important step forward for the industry." This comes amid pressure from Meta and follows a significant legal settlement.
summary.zh: Snap Inc. 首席执行官埃文·斯皮格尔在接受英国广播公司（BBC）采访时表示，该公司愿意为青少年用户实施每日使用时长限制，并称这将是“行业向前迈出的重要一步”。此前，Meta 公司曾施压要求其采取行动，并且该公司最近达成了一项重大的法律和解。

body.en:
The boss of Snapchat-parent Snap Inc says the firm would be "willing to implement" time limits for teens, following a call from Meta for it to take action.

Evan Spiegel told the BBC in an interview at the company's California headquarters that setting a maximum amount of time that young users could spend on the app could be "an important step forward for the industry. "

His comments came as Snap revealed a slew of new features for its upcoming Specs glasses, which it said could connect to Apple iPhone and Mac devices.

Meta has been pressuring other social media companies to join it in making platform changes it agreed to as part of a recent multi-billion dollar legal settlement with US states.

Instagram and Facebook-parent Meta was facing allegations from Attorneys General for most US states who said the firm deliberately designed its apps to be addictive to young users.

It agreed to pay $12.7bn and implement a two-hour daily limit for teen users across its platforms by default, in addition to muted notifications during school hours, blocks at night and other measures.

"I think it is an important step forward in the industry in terms of really identifying industry norms, and I think that would be beneficial overall," Spiegel told the BBC. "We've looked really thoughtfully at the terms."

As part of Meta's August settlement , the company said it would implement even more stringent time limits and pay an additional $5.3bn if YouTube and TikTok follow suit. It has denied any wrongdoing as part of the deal, which will be paid over a 10-year period.

Last month, a Meta spokesperson said it was hopeful that Snap would make similar platform changes as well.

Meta, YouTube, TikTok and Snap have all faced a barrage of litigation alleging their apps have helped spawn a youth mental health crisis. Snap has also been accused of facilitating illegal drug sales.

When asked about the idea of a default time limit, Spiegel said: "I think that's a really good example of something that that we'd be willing to implement."

"That's something we've talked about internally," he said. "I don't have more to share today."

He noted that Snap offers tools through its Family Center feature, which currently enables parents to track aspects of how their teens are using Snapchat.

YouTube-parent Google said it had no comment when asked if it planned to implement the measures in Meta's settlement. TikTok did not respond to the BBC's request for comment.

Spiegel was talking to the BBC as Snapchat's parent Snap Inc announced new features for its upcoming Specs glasses.

He said the smart eyewear would use AI to suggest things for people to do based on what the tech learns about their goals, relationships and routines.

body.zh: Snapchat 母公司 Snap Inc 的老板表示，在 Meta 呼吁其采取行动后，该公司将“愿意实施”青少年的时间限制。 埃文·斯皮格尔 (Evan Spiegel) 在该公司加州总部接受 BBC 采访时表示，设定年轻用户可以在该应用上花费的最大时间可能是“该行业向前迈出的重要一步”。 在他发表此番言论之际，Snap 透露了即将推出的 Specs 眼镜的一系列新功能，据称该眼镜可以连接到苹果 iPhone 和 Mac 设备。 Meta 一直在向其他社交媒体公司施压，要求它们加入到平台变更中，作为最近与美国各州达成的数十亿美元法律和解协议的一部分。 Instagram 和 Facebook 母公司 Meta 面临美国大多数州总检察长的指控，他们称该公司故意设计其应用程序，让年轻用户上瘾。 它同意支付 127 亿美元，并默认在其平台上对青少年用户实行每日两小时的限制，此外还采取了在上课期间静音通知、夜间封锁等措施。 斯皮格尔告诉英国广播公司：“我认为，就真正确定行业规范而言，这是该行业向前迈出的重要一步，而且我认为这总体上是有益的。” “我们非常仔细地考虑了这些条款。” 作为 Meta 8 月份和解协议的一部分，该公司表示，如果 YouTube 和 TikTok 效仿，它将实施更严格的时间限制，并额外支付 53 亿美元。该公司否认交易中有任何不当行为，这笔交易将在 10 年内支付。 上个月，Meta 发言人表示，希望 Snap 也能做出类似的平台改变。 Meta、YouTube、TikTok 和 Snap 都面临着一系列诉讼，指控他们的应用程序助长了青少年心理健康危机。 Snap 还被指控为非法药品销售提供便利。 当被问及默认时间限制的想法时，斯皮格尔说：“我认为这是我们愿意实施的一个很好的例子。” “这是我们内部讨论过的事情，”他说。 “今天我没有更多要分享的了。” 他指出，Snap 通过其家庭中心功能提供工具，目前该功能使家长能够跟踪青少年如何使用 Snapchat。 当被问及是否计划实施 Meta 和解协议中的措施时，YouTube 母公司谷歌表示不予置评。 TikTok 没有回应 BBC 的置评请求。 Spiegel 在接受 BBC 采访时，Snapchat 的母公司 Snap Inc 宣布了即将推出的 Specs 眼镜的新功能。 他表示，智能眼镜将使用人工智能，根据技术对人们的目标、关系和惯例的了解，建议人们做什么。 “而不是人们今天使用聊天机器人的方式......

reflection.en: In an age saturated with digital stimuli, the call for limits on screen time, especially for young users, highlights a growing awareness of the need for mental discipline. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, and praiseworthy. This principle can guide both the developers creating...
reflection.zh: 在这个充斥着数字刺激的时代，呼吁限制屏幕使用时间，尤其是对年轻用户而言，凸显了人们日益认识到精神自律的必要性。《腓立比书》4章8节鼓励我们将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事。这一原则可以指导平台开发者和年轻用户，促进与科技更健康的互动。

title.en: Inside Singapore's 'Fort Knox' for city's $2bn dirty money auction
title.zh: 新加坡的肮脏钱拍卖：手袋、珠宝和手表

summary.en: Singapore is auctioning luxury items confiscated in a $2.2 billion money laundering investigation. The BBC gained access to a secure facility holding these seized goods, which are now being sold off.
summary.zh: 新加坡开始拍卖警方在2023年震惊该国的22亿美元洗钱案中查获的奢侈品。BBC记者得以进入存放这些物品的加固仓库一探究竟。

body.en:
Singapore has begun auctioning off luxury goods that were seized by police in a sensational $2.2 billion money laundering case that gripped the city state in 2023.

The items are being held inside Le Freeport, a fortified storage facility, where the BBC's Vandhna Bhan was allowed inside for a look.
body.zh: 新加坡已开始拍卖警方在 2023 年席卷新加坡的一起轰动一时的 22 亿美元洗钱案中查获的奢侈品。 这些物品被存放在 Le Freeport 一个戒备森严的储存设施内，BBC 的 Vandhna Bhan 被允许进去参观。

reflection.en: The sight of luxury goods—handbags, jewels, watches—up for auction in Singapore, seized in a $2.2 billion money laundering case, starkly illustrates the destructive power of greed. The pursuit of wealth, when untethered from integrity, can lead to vast illicit schemes and the accumulation of ill-gotten gains. This serves as a somber reminder that 'the love...
reflection.zh: 新加坡拍卖会上展示的奢侈品——手袋、珠宝和手表——是在一起价值22亿美元的洗钱案中被查获的，这鲜明地展示了贪婪的破坏力。当对财富的追求与正直脱节时，它可能导致大规模的非法计划和不义之财的积累。这令人警醒地提醒我们，“贪财是万恶之根”（提摩太前书 6:10），这一原则在这样的新闻报道中得到了悲剧性的体现。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: US Federal Reserve raises interest rates for the first time since 2023, defying Trump
title.zh: 美联储自2023年来首次加息，特朗普要求降息至1%以下

summary.en: The US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates by 0.25 percentage points, marking the first increase since 2023. This move goes against the demands of President Donald Trump, who publicly called for rates to be below 1 percent, stating the US could no longer "carry" other nations.
summary.zh: 美国联邦储备委员会将利率提高了0.25个百分点，这是自2023年以来的首次加息。此举与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的要求背道而驰，他公开呼吁将利率降至1%以下，并表示美国已无法再“负担”其他国家。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has demanded interest rates be cut to 1 per cent after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates on Thursday for the first time since 2023.

The Fed voted unanimously to raise rates by 0.25 percentage points, saying the rate hike would support a "timelier return" to its 2 per cent target for inflation.

It was a blow for Trump, who appointed central bank chief Kevin Warsh in the hopes that he would lower rates.

Trump took to his social media platform Truth Social to speak out against the rise, saying rates should be less than 1 per cent and that the US could no longer "carry" other countries.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Interest Rates in the United States should be 1%, or less, because we are the Best Credit in the World — BY FAR," Trump wrote on Thursday morning.

He said that if they stopped trading with countries with a deficit, the US would make "at least" US$1.5 trillion ($2.1 trillion) a year. He did not cite a source for that figure.

"We are "carrying" almost every country in the World, and that cannot go on any longer," he added, before ending with: "LOWER THE INTEREST RATES FOR THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, AND FAST!"

It's ‌the first policy shift ‌under the new Fed chief, ⁠who took office in late May after being selected by Trump with an expectation that he would cut rates.

Warsh stressed the need to combat inflation that has been "too high" for "too long" and said the decision was a "serious" one, but needed to be taken.

"The plain fact is that inflation is too high, and has been for too long," he told a press conference.

And the hike may not be the last — the vast majority of Fed policymakers indicated that at least one more rate hike was likely necessary before the end of the year, according to their Summary of Economic Projections.

US households and businesses have been battered by years of higher-than-target inflation, and prices have surged in the wake of Trump's war on Iran, his signature tariff policies and the ongoing AI boom.

Trump has launched an unprecedented assault on the Fed's independence since taking office, attempting to fire a Fed governor and launching a criminal probe against Warsh's predecessor in his quest for lower rates to spur economic activity.

Trump's Republican Party faces a stern test in the upcoming midterm elections, with rival Democrats seeking to wrest control of both houses of Congress and with economic issues front and centre for voters.

US stock markets largely priced in Thursday's rate hike, but they were still down on the news — expected with any rate hike as equities become less attractive.

body.zh: 在美联储周四自 2023 年以来首次加息后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普要求将利率降至 1%。 美联储一致投票决定加息0.25个百分点，称加息将支持“及时回归”2%的通胀目标。 这对特朗普来说是一个打击，他任命了央行行长凯文·沃什，希望他能降低利率。 特朗普在他的社交媒体平台Truth Social上公开反对加息，称利率应该低于1%，并且美国不能再“拖累”其他国家。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 特朗普周四上午写道：“美国的利率应该为 1% 或更低，因为我们是迄今为止世界上最好的信用国。” 他声称，如果他们停止与有赤字的国家进行贸易，美国每年将赚取“至少”1.5万亿美元。 他补充道：“我们正在‘承受’世界上几乎每个国家，这种情况不能再继续下去了。”最后他说：“降低美国的利率，而且要快！” 这是新任美联储主席领导下的首次政策转变，特朗普于 5 月底上任后，预计他会降息。 沃什强调，有必要对抗持续“太长时间”“过高”的通胀，并表示这一决定是“严肃的”，但需要做出。 他在新闻发布会上表示：“显而易见的事实是，通胀太高，而且持续太久了。” 这次加息可能不是最后一次——根据经济预测摘要，绝大多数美联储政策制定者表示，在年底前可能至少需要再加息一次。 美国家庭和企业多年来一直受到高于目标的通货膨胀的打击，在特朗普对伊朗的战争、他标志性的关税政策和持续的人工智能热潮之后，物价飙升。 自上任以来，特朗普对美联储的独立性发起了前所未有的攻击，试图解雇一名美联储理事，并对沃什的前任发起刑事调查，以寻求更低的利率以刺激经济活动。 总统领导的共和党在即将到来的中期选举中面临着严峻的考验，竞争对手民主党寻求夺取国会参众两院的控制权，经济问题成为选民关注的焦点。 美国股市在很大程度上已消化了周四的加息消息，但仍因这一消息而下跌——预计随着股市吸引力下降，任何加息都会出现。 十年期美国国债收益率——...

Proverbs 22:7 warns, "The borrower is slave to the lender." This ancient wisdom speaks to the delicate balance of financial interdependence and the burdens that can arise from it, whether...
reflection.zh: 美联储加息的决定以及特朗普总统的强烈反对，凸显了全球经济复杂的金融纠葛。《箴言》22:7警示说：“欠债的是债主的仆人。”这古老的智慧道出了金融相互依存的微妙平衡，以及由此可能产生的负担，无论是在国家之间还是个人之间。

title.en: UK: Village votes to 'secede' in asylum center plan protest
title.zh: 英国：村庄投票“脱离”以抗议移民接收中心计划

summary.en: Residents of Piddington, a small English village, have held a symbolic referendum to 'secede' from the UK. This action is a protest against government plans to establish an asylum reception center at a nearby disused military base.
summary.zh: 英格兰一个偏远小村庄皮丁顿的居民举行了一次象征性的“脱离”英国的公投。此举是为了抗议政府计划在附近一个废弃的军事基地设立接收寻求庇护者的中心。

body.zh: 英国牛津郡的一个偏远小村庄皮丁顿的居民就离开英国举行了“公投”。他们反对在附近废弃军事基地开设庇护接待中心的计划。 一个约有350人的英国村庄投票决定“脱离”英国，以象征性抗议政府计划在附近设立庇护接待中心。 周三，位于牛津东北约25公里（15英里）处的皮丁顿的居民在村庄路标附近举起了写着“皮丁顿公国”的标语牌来庆祝。 他们反对将寻求庇护者安置在废弃的国防部比斯特军事基地（A 点）的计划，该计划仍在审查中。 该村的教区委员会表示，有 312 人参加了投票，投票率接近 92%。 此次投票没有法律依据，参与者被要求同意或不同意以下声明：“我支持皮丁顿寻求脱离英国并追求自决。” 教区委员会主席蒂姆·麦克纳利表示，展望未来，该村庄将被认定为“皮丁顿公国”。 “对我们来说，这关系到比例，”麦克纳利告诉天空新闻。 “一个只有 350 多人的小村庄如何与 1,250 名男性同化？” 牛津郡议会的一名官员告诉英国广播公司，该计划有可能使该村庄和该设施成为潜在的暴力极右抗议活动的“避雷针”。 此次投票引起了网上自称反移民“影响者”的关注。 工党政府一直试图在 2029 年之前将住在酒店的寻求庇护者转移到废弃的军事设施中，这是他们从前任英国政府那里继承下来的不受欢迎的遗产。 此前，在酒店或用于此目的的出租房屋内或附近多次发生抗议活动。 最近刚刚接任英国政坛迅速轮换的最高职位的首相安迪·伯纳姆承诺“考虑社区和公投中提出的问题”。 但他也表示，“绝大多数”英国人支持政府停止将寻求庇护者安置在酒店的计划，并认为在全国各地设立收容中心是“公平的”。 文化大臣丽莎·南迪在接受英国广播公司采访时表示，与酒店或出租房屋相比，前军事基地是“为寻求庇护者提供更好的住宿选择”。 然而，废弃军事基地的一个缺点是，它们通常被有意放置在偏远和农村地区。这对于军事训练和活动来说是理想的选择，但显然不太适合为流动性和资源有限的移民提供住房。 几十年来，移民和庇护一直是英国有争议的政治问题。但接连...

Their action stems from opposition to plans for an asylum reception center, highlighting a community's desire to have its voice heard on matters affecting its future. This echoes the call to speak up for the vulnerable and to advocate...
reflection.zh: 在皮丁顿这个约有350人的村庄，居民们通过投票“脱离”英国的方式进行象征性抗议。他们的行动源于反对设立接收寻求庇护者中心的计划，这突显了一个社区希望在影响其未来的事务上发出声音的愿望。这呼应了为弱势群体发声、为那些可能被忽视的情况进行倡导的呼召。

title.en: Can Canada and the EU build a deeper partnership?
title.zh: 加拿大和欧盟能否建立更深厚的伙伴关系？

summary.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, known for his stance against US President Donald Trump, is seeking to establish a 'unique alliance' with Europe. This potential partnership, which might involve Canada becoming an 'associate member' of the EU without full membership, has been met with openness by European...
summary.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼以其对抗美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的立场而闻名，他正寻求与欧洲建立一种“独特的联盟”。这种潜在的伙伴关系，可能涉及加拿大成为欧盟的“联系成员国”而非正式成员，已得到欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩的积极回应。

body.en:
Canadian Prime Minister Carney is known for standing up to US President Donald Trump. Now he wants to forge a "unique alliance" with Europe. But what could such a partnership look like?

Before taking off for Europe, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney had set the tone for his visit, saying he was seeking to build a "unique alliance" with the EU . The Wall Street Journal similarly reported that Canada was considering becoming an "associate member" of the EU, while not aiming for full membership.

In her State of the European Union address on Wednesday, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen indicated that she was indeed open to such an expanded partnership.

"We believe that power does not belong to the strongest, the richest or the loudest, but to all of us," she said, addressing European lawmakers and Carney in Strasbourg, France. "That democracies have the freedom to choose with whom to work."

Von der Leyen said a EU-Canada partnership would cover a broad range of areas including advanced manufacturing, technology, defense production, the Arctic, energy, critical minerals, batteries, artificial intelligence, quantum computing, cybersecurity and economic security.

Carney is expected to outline his vision for future relations between the EU and Canada during a speech at the European Parliament on Thursday.

EU member states are closely integrated economically, sharing a common market, trade and customs policy. When it comes to establishing ties with non-EU countries, a list of different options present themselves. They range from free trade agreements that scrap tariffs and trade barriers, to association agreements which may include political elements, to far-reaching economic arrangements such as participation in the common European market, as is the case for Iceland , Liechtenstein and Norway.

The EU has already negotiated association agreements with Turkey, Israel and Ukraine. These have different objectives and may or may not mark a preliminary step toward full membership.

Patrick Leblond, an expert on international economic relations at the University of Ottawa, urges a little more caution around the term "association agreement." He considers it unlikely that Canada would adopt European laws or join the EU single market or customs union, which would mean imposing common external tariffs.

Leblond says Carney is likely more interested in forming a kind of alliance that deepens cooperation on issues of economic security and defense.

"We have, in a way, taken the US [security] umbrella for granted on both sides. We have underinvested in our militaries," Leblond told DW.

He added that the focus was now on joining forces, for example in the production of military equipment and the development of new...
body.zh: 加拿大总理卡尼以对抗美国总统唐纳德·特朗普而闻名。现在他想与欧洲建立一个“独特的联盟”。但这样的伙伴关系会是什么样子呢？ 在启程前往欧洲之前，加拿大总理马克·卡尼为此次访问定下了基调，称他正在寻求与欧盟建立“独特的联盟”。 《华尔街日报》同样报道称，加拿大正在考虑成为欧盟的“准成员”，但并不打算成为正式成员。 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在周三的欧盟国情演讲中表示，她确实对扩大伙伴关系持开放态度。 她在法国斯特拉斯堡向欧洲立法者和卡尼发表讲话时表示：“我们相信，权力不属于最强大、最富有或最响亮的人，而是属于我们所有人。” “民主国家可以自由选择与谁合作。” 冯德莱恩表示，欧盟与加拿大的伙伴关系将涵盖广泛的领域，包括先进制造、技术、国防生产、北极、能源、关键矿产、电池、人工智能、量子计算、网络安全和经济安全。 预计卡尼周四在欧洲议会发表演讲时将概述他对欧盟与加拿大未来关系的愿景。 欧盟成员国经济紧密结合，共享共同的市场、贸易和海关政策。当谈到与非欧盟国家建立关系时，会出现一系列不同的选择。它们的范围从取消关税和贸易壁垒的自由贸易协定，到可能包含政治因素的联合协定，再到影响深远的经济安排，例如参与欧洲共同市场，如冰岛、列支敦士登和挪威的情况。 欧盟已经与土耳其、以色列和乌克兰谈判了联系协定。它们有不同的目标，可能会也可能不会标志着成为正式会员的初步步骤。 渥太华大学国际经济关系专家帕特里克·勒布朗德（Patrick Leblond）敦促人们对“联盟协议”一词更加谨慎。他认为加拿大不太可能采用欧洲法律或加入欧盟单一市场或关税同盟，这意味着征收共同的外部关税。 勒布朗德表示，卡尼可能更感兴趣的是建立一种联盟，以加深在经济安全和国防问题上的合作。 “在某种程度上，我们把美国[安全]保护伞视为理所当然。我们对军队的投资不足，”勒布朗德告诉德国之声。 他补充说，现在的重点是联合起来，例如在军事装备的生产和新...

reflection.en: In international relations, as in any endeavor, the path forward is often complex and uncertain. The pursuit of a 'unique alliance' between Canada and the EU requires careful consideration and wise counsel. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a nation falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' May leaders on all sides...
reflection.zh: 在国际关系中，如同在任何事业中一样，前进的道路往往是复杂且充满不确定性的。加拿大与欧盟之间寻求建立“独特的联盟”需要深思熟虑和明智的建议。《箴言》11章14节提醒我们：“ in an abundance of counselors there is safety.”（在谋士众多之处，有安全。）愿各方领导人都能寻求建立强大且有益伙伴关系所需的智慧。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Shock in Kosovo as Hague convicts former President Thaci
title.zh: 科索沃前总统塔奇被判有罪，海牙引发震惊

summary.en: The conviction of former President Hashim Thaci and three other former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders by a war crimes tribunal in The Hague has caused shock and disappointment in Kosovo. Thousands gathered in Pristina's main square to follow the verdict live, waving KLA flags, with similar gatherings occurring...
summary.zh: 前总统哈希姆·塔奇和另外三名前科索沃解放军领导人在海牙被战争罪法庭定罪，这在科索沃引发了震惊和失望。数千人在普里什蒂纳的主广场聚集，挥舞着科索沃解放军旗帜，实时关注判决结果，全国各地也发生了类似的集会。

body.en:
The conviction in The Hague of former President Hashim Thaci and three former Kosovo Liberation Army leaders has caused consternation in Kosovo — both among political leaders and on the streets. DW reports from Pristina.

The announcement of the verdict was greeted with shock and profound disappointment in Pristina.

Thousands of citizens had gathered in the main square of Kosovo's capital, many waving flags of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA), to follow the announcement live on large screens. Similar gatherings took place across the country in Kosovo's main cities.

When it became clear that the Kosovo war crimes tribunal in The Hague had found former President Hashim Thaci guilty of war crimes — along with former Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) leaders Kadri Veseli, Jakup Krasniqi and Rexhep Selimi — the crowd fell silent.

The silence was followed by calls for justice and chants of support for the four men.

Groups of citizens began trying to demolish sections of the perimeter wall surrounding EULEX, the EU Rule of Law Mission in Kosovo , which was deployed in Kosovo after the country's declaration of independence from Serbia in 2008 and continues to operate to this day.

Large numbers of Kosovo police officers and special units intervened to prevent further damage and incidents.

It wasn't just the people on the streets who were disappointed: Kosovo's political leaders were quick to respond to the news from The Hague.

"The conviction of the former KLA leaders is a terrible judgment for Kosovo, for our liberation war," said Foreign Minister Glauk Konjufca, who was present in the courtroom in The Hague when the verdict was announced. He called it "a major blow to the state and to the domestic narrative."

"Kosovo experienced the war itself. We know what the KLA war was about, and we know that there was no criminal mechanism to harm any population. It is a sad, unjust and undeserved decision," he said.

Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti called the verdict an "unacceptable injustice."

"The conviction and such a severe sentence for four former leaders of the Kosovo Liberation Army is an unacceptable injustice, a great and harmful punishment," Kurti said on Wednesday.

The Democratic Party of Kosovo (PDK), which was founded immediately after the war by Thaci and several other former KLA leaders, described the guilty verdict as an "unjust and unacceptable judgment," stressing that "the battle for justice continues until the very end."

"In The Hague, the right of our people, who fought for freedom, survival and liberation from the Serbian state regime that killed, expelled and terrorized Kosovo Albanians, was dealt a severe blow," the PDK said in a statement. "For us, this judgment represents a major injustice because it is based on...
body.zh: 海牙对前总统哈希姆·塔奇和三名前科索沃解放军领导人的定罪在科索沃引起了政治领导人和街头的恐慌。德国之声从普里什蒂纳报道。 判决的宣布引起了普里什蒂纳的震惊和深深的失望。 数千名公民聚集在科索沃首都的主广场，许多人挥舞着科索沃解放军的旗帜，观看大屏幕上直播的公告。科索沃全国主要城市也举行了类似的集会。 当海牙的科索沃战争罪法庭明确裁定前总统哈希姆·塔奇以及科索沃解放军前领导人卡德里·维塞利、雅库普·克拉斯尼奇和雷杰普·塞利米犯有战争罪时，人群陷入了沉默。 沉默之后，人们呼吁伸张正义，并高呼支持这四人。 公民团体开始试图拆除欧盟驻科索沃法治特派团（欧盟驻科索沃法治特派团）周围的部分围墙，该特派团于 2008 年科索沃宣布脱离塞尔维亚独立后部署在科索沃，并一直运作至今。 大量科索沃警察和特种部队进行干预，以防止进一步的损害和事件。 失望的不仅仅是街头民众：科索沃政治领导人对来自海牙的消息迅速做出了回应。 “科索沃解放军前领导人的定罪对于科索沃、对于我们的解放战争来说是一个可怕的判决，”判决宣布时在海牙法庭的外交部长格劳克·孔尤夫察说。他称其为“对国家和国内叙事的重大打击”。 “科索沃本身经历了战争。我们知道科索沃解放军战争的意义，我们也知道没有任何刑事机制可以伤害任何人民。这是一个悲伤、不公正和不应有的决定，”他说。 科索沃总理阿尔宾·库尔蒂称这一判决是“不可接受的不公正”。 库尔蒂周三表示：“对科索沃解放军四名前领导人的定罪和如此严厉的判决是一种令人无法接受的不公正，是一种巨大而有害的惩罚。” 塔奇和其他几位前科索沃解放军领导人在战后立即成立的科索沃民主党（PDK）将有罪判决描述为“不公正且不可接受的判决”，并强调“正义之战将持续到最后”。 民主党在一份声明中表示：“在海牙，我们人民的权利受到了严重打击，他们为自由、生存和从杀害、驱逐和恐吓科索沃阿尔巴尼亚人的塞尔维亚国家政权下解放而奋斗。” “对我们来说，这一判决代表着重大的不公正，因为它是基于......

reflection.en: The news from The Hague brings a somber reminder that justice, though often delayed, can eventually arrive. The conviction of former President Thaci and other leaders for war crimes underscores the principle that accountability is essential, even for those who once held positions of power. It is a difficult moment for Kosovo, but one that speaks to the...
reflection.zh: 海牙传来的消息令人沉重地提醒我们，正义或许迟到，但终究会到来。前总统塔奇及其他领导人因战争罪被定罪，这凸显了问责制的重要性，即使是对那些曾身居高位者而言。这对科索沃来说是一个艰难的时刻，但它也体现了人类对正义和法治的持久追求。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: British-American writer Bonnie Greer dies aged 77
title.zh: 英美作家邦妮·格里尔去世，享年77岁

summary.en: Bonnie Greer, a Chicago-born playwright and prominent British political commentator, has died at the age of 77. Her husband, David Hutchins, announced her passing.
summary.zh: 芝加哥出生的剧作家、英国知名政治评论员邦妮·格里尔（Bonnie Greer）去世，享年77岁。她的丈夫大卫·哈钦斯（David Hutchins）宣布了她的逝世消息。

body.zh: 出生于芝加哥的剧作家邦妮·格里尔去世，她后来成为英国政治话语中的熟悉面孔。她的丈夫大卫·哈钦斯宣布了格里尔去世的消息。 剧作家兼作家邦妮·格里尔 (Bonnie Greer) 的丈夫大卫·哈钦斯 (David Hutchins) 周三在给英国媒体的一份声明中表示，她去世，享年 77 岁。 格里尔是一位出生于芝加哥的著名作家，最初在纽约从事写作，成年后的大部分时间都在英国度过。 她获得了双重国籍，并成为英国知名的定期政治评论员。 格里尔的鳏夫哈钦斯称赞她是“一位著名的剧作家、作家、评论家、文化和政治评论员，她的智慧、勇气和独特的声音为英国文化和公共生活做出了持久的贡献”。 他说，那些与格里尔最亲近的人都会记得她的热情、幽默、慷慨以及将人们聚集在一起的非凡能力。 哈钦斯说：“对我来说，她是我的伴侣、知己和灵感来源，我非常荣幸能与她分享我的生活。”格里尔移民七年后，两人于 1993 年结婚。 格里尔 1948 年出生于芝加哥，是密西西比佃农家庭七个孩子中的长子。 她的家庭早在她出生之前就接触了英国——她的父亲本在第二次世界大战期间驻扎在英国，并参加了诺曼底登陆。 在一位大学教授告诉她他不认为女性应该从事法律职业后，她在美国民权运动中转向了创意写作。 在芝加哥学习戏剧后，她作为一名有抱负的年轻作家搬到了纽约。 格里尔于 1986 年定居英国，主要从事女性和少数民族戏剧表演。 她于 1997 年获得英国公民身份，并创作了一系列成功的广播剧和音乐剧，并在 BBC 上播出。她 1993 年的戏剧《Munda Negra》探讨了黑人女性的心理健康问题，荣获 Verity Bargate 最佳戏剧奖。 格里尔还经常为英国政治和社会辩论撰稿，经常出现在“新闻之夜”和“提问时间”等热门节目中。 格里尔是巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 的杰出支持者，并于 2009 年撰写了回忆录和个人音乐史，名为《奥巴马音乐》。她还大约在同一时间发起反对英国脱欧、英国脱欧和唐纳德·特朗普担任美国总统的第一个任期的活动。 她担任过一系列文化职务，包括勃朗特协会主席、伦敦泰晤士河畔金斯顿大学校长、英国皇家文学学会会员、皇家歌剧院和伦敦电影学院董事会成员。 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报告，请花点时间...

reflection.en: Bonnie Greer, a celebrated playwright and commentator, has passed away at 77. Her life, marked by creative work and public engagement, now concludes. Hebrews 9:27 reminds us that death is a universal appointment, a shared human experience that calls us to reflect on the brevity of our time and the eternal perspective.
reflection.zh: 备受赞誉的剧作家和评论员邦妮·格里尔（Bonnie Greer）已于77岁辞世。她的一生，以创作和公共参与为标志，如今已告一段落。希伯来书9:27提醒我们，死亡是人人必经的定数，是共同的人类经历，促使我们反思生命的短暂和永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: EU proposes landmark associate membership for Canada
title.zh: 欧盟提议加拿大成为首个“准成员国”

summary.en: The European Union has proposed offering Canada associate membership, a novel category of partnership not currently defined in its treaties, signaling a significant policy shift in how the bloc engages with international allies.
summary.zh: 欧盟提议向加拿大提供准成员国身份，这是一种欧盟条约中未明确规定的新型伙伴关系，标志着该集团在与国际盟友互动方式上的重大政策转变。

body.en:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the European Union is opening the door for Canada to become its first "associate member", a status that is not set out in the bloc's treaties.

Von der Leyen's announcement is a significant shift in EU policy. The bloc has historically resisted flexible categories and EU members were lukewarm in reacting to Germany's proposal in May of associate membership for Ukraine as a stepping stone to full accession.

"Partnerships are a strategic choice for Europe. But they also respond to the fracture in the international rules-based system," von der Leyen said in her annual State of the European Union address to the European Parliament in Strasbourg.

"We see the world with the same eyes: from AI to climate change, from the Arctic to geopolitics. And we have stood together: on Ukraine, on defence, on raw materials and on supply chains. But above all ... Europe and Canada believe in democracy."

Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney said earlier this week Canada was seeking a "unique alliance" with the EU but not membership. Von der Leyen invited Carney to join her in Strasbourg, and he will make his own address on Thursday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Carney's European trip follows a historic breakdown in Canada-US relations after trade talks collapsed last month, sparking a series of tit-for-tat tariff measures.

"I said we must urgently reimagine our partnerships. So, I would like to work with you on opening the door for Canada to be the first associate member of the EU," von der Leyen said.

She added that the EU and Canada will work together across sectors from manufacturing to AI, critical minerals and energy.

"We will work on intelligent manufacturing. We will create a tech alliance. We will integrate defence industrial bases. We will make the Arctic a flagship joint project," she said.

Von der Leyen added it was "a partnership not against anyone else", in a possible effort to avoid antagonising United States President Donald Trump.

body.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，欧盟正在为加拿大成为其第一个“准成员”敞开大门，欧盟条约中没有规定这一地位。 冯德莱恩的声明是欧盟政策的重大转变。欧盟历来抵制灵活的类别，欧盟成员国对德国五月份提出的让乌克兰成为准成员身份作为全面加入的垫脚石的提议反应冷淡。 冯德莱恩在斯特拉斯堡欧洲议会年度欧盟国情咨文中表示：“伙伴关系是欧洲的战略选择。但它们也是对基于国际规则的体系破裂的回应。” “我们用同样的眼睛看世界：从人工智能到气候变化，从北极到地缘政治。我们在乌克兰、国防、原材料和供应链上都站在一起。但最重要的是……欧洲和加拿大相信民主。” 加拿大总理马克·卡尼本周早些时候表示，加拿大正在寻求与欧盟建立“独特联盟”，但不寻求加入欧盟。冯德莱恩邀请卡尼前往斯特拉斯堡与她会面，他将于周四发表自己的讲话。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 卡尼的欧洲之行是在上个月贸易谈判破裂并引发一系列针锋相对的关税措施后，加美关系出现历史性破裂之后进行的。 “我说我们必须紧急重新构想我们的伙伴关系。因此，我愿意与你们合作，为加拿大成为欧盟第一个准成员打开大门，”冯德莱恩说。 她补充说，欧盟和加拿大将在从制造业到人工智能、关键矿产和能源等各个领域开展合作。 “我们将致力于智能制造。我们将创建一个技术联盟。我们将整合国防工业基地。我们将把北极打造成一个旗舰联合项目，”她说。 冯德莱恩补充说，“这是一种不针对任何其他人的伙伴关系”，可能是为了避免激怒美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In a world marked by shifting geopolitical landscapes and evolving international relations, the EU's proposal for Canada to become an 'associate member' represents a creative response to changing times. This move suggests a recognition that established frameworks may need to adapt to new realities and partnerships, echoing the idea that knowledge and...
reflection.zh: 在一个地缘政治格局不断变化、国际关系不断演变的时代，欧盟提议加拿大成为“准成员国”，这代表了对时代变迁的创造性回应。这一举措表明，人们认识到现有的框架可能需要适应新的现实和伙伴关系，这与知识和理解不断扩展、需要新的组织和交往方式的观念相呼应。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: An unexpected move by the US has sparked anger from China and Russia
title.zh: 美国出人意料的举动引发中俄愤怒

summary.en: Russia and China have expressed alarm at the revelation, warning against the idea of space becoming a "battlefield". The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a move that has sparked anger from China and Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯和中国对这一消息表示震惊，警告太空可能成为“战场”。美国首次证实已在太空部署武器，此举引发了中国和俄罗斯的愤怒。

body.en:
The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In his remarks to the Air and Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference on Tuesday AEST, Meink also said the Air Force was adding more autonomous systems to its capabilities and predicted the service would look "radically different" by 2032.

For example, he foresaw one-way attack drones replacing artillery as the "primary killer".

Analysts said that the revelation by the US confirmed an open secret, but the timing of the announcement risked exacerbating tensions with China and the risk of a weapons race in space.

In 2019, during his first term, US President Donal Trump created the Space Force as a separate military branch. In his second term, he has announced the Golden Dome missile defence system, which includes plans to put US weapons in space.

The United States has confirmed for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space, a remarkable revelation after warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponising a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

US Air Force secretary Troy Meink said the US has fielded "on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action".

Meink did not detail what the weapons were, how they work or if they were targeting other objects in space or on Earth.

The US had warned two years ago that Russia was developing a new space-based, anti-satellite weapon, though the White House said the danger wasn't imminent at the time.

But reports of the anti-satellite weapon reflected longstanding worries about space threats from Russia and China, given that much US infrastructure is dependent on satellite communications. The US has also previously demonstrated its own abilities to shoot down satellites from Earth.

body.en:
Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

A study by a US foreign policy think tank advocates a major military pullback from the western Pacific, prompting concern among long-standing allies of the United States across the Indo-Pacific, analysts say.

The report  was authored by Jennifer Kavanagh, a senior fellow and director of military analysis at the right-of-center Defense Priorities Foundation. Kavanagh calls for the US to "narrow its defense commitments in the region" by ending mutual defense alliances with South Korea , Japan , Australia and the Philippines .

The priority for Washington, she states, is to defend the US homeland and safeguard access to key economic markets and trade routes. That would be best served by pulling back from the "first island chain," which runs from Okinawa in southern Japan, through Taiwan and on to the Philippines.

Kavanagh writes that US forces should be pared back and moved to the "second island chain," which runs from eastern Japan to the Northern Marianas Islands in the central Pacific, Guam, Palau and on to Papua New Guinea.

The report states that moving the troops back would make their positions easier to defend and "reduce the risk of a catastrophic war with China."

Such a withdrawal would arguably be most keenly felt in Taiwan , which Beijing views as a renegade province that must one day be assimilated into greater China .

In her report, Kavanagh notes that the US has no formal commitment to come to the assistance of Taiwan in the event of an attack by China. She warns that any armed clash "would come at an exorbitant cost for the United States, far in excess of any benefits."

"With a cost-benefit calculation this lopsided, a change in the US commitment to Taiwan seems wise," she said. "The United States should shift from strategic ambiguity to a clear non-intervention policy in the event of any military confrontation over Taiwan."

The countries named in the report have made no formal comments on the think tank's proposals, but its conclusions "will be viewed with shock," William Yang, a Taiwan-based security analyst for the International Crisis Group, told DW.

The concern will be even deeper given that the Defense Priorities Foundation is known for its isolationist foreign and defense policy positions and is reputed to have ties with a number of senior and like-minded decision-makers in the White House, Yang said.

Yang noted that US President Donald Trump has repeatedly threatened to withdraw troops from allied nations in Europe and Asia if his demands for larger payments or concessions in some other area of the bilateral relationship were not met, Yang...
body.zh: 分析人士警告说，正如一家智库最近建议的那样，美国从西太平洋撤军将削弱威慑力并加强中国的地位。 分析人士称，美国外交政策智囊团的一项研究主张从西太平洋地区大规模撤军，这引起了美国在印太地区的长期盟友的担忧。 该报告的作者詹妮弗·卡瓦纳 (Jennifer Kavanagh) 是中右翼国防优先基金会的高级研究员兼军事分析主任。卡瓦纳呼吁美国终止与韩国、日本、澳大利亚和菲律宾的共同防御联盟，“缩小其在该地区的防务承诺”。 她表示，华盛顿的首要任务是保卫美国本土并保障进入主要经济市场和贸易路线的机会。最好的办法是从“第一岛链”撤军，该岛链从日本南部的冲绳岛，穿过台湾，一直延伸到菲律宾。 卡瓦纳写道，美军应该削减规模，并转移到“第二岛链”，该岛链从日本东部到太平洋中部的北马里亚纳群岛、关岛、帕劳，再到巴布亚新几内亚。 报告指出，撤军将使他们的阵地更容易保卫，并“减少与中国发生灾难性战争的风险”。 可以说，这种撤军对台湾的感受最为强烈，北京将台湾视为一个叛逆的省份，有一天必须被纳入大中华区。 卡瓦纳在报告中指出，美国没有正式承诺在台湾遭受中国袭击时向台湾提供援助。她警告说，任何武装冲突“都会给美国带来高昂的代价，远远超过任何好处”。 她说：“鉴于成本效益计算如此不平衡，美国改变对台湾的承诺似乎是明智的。” “如果台湾问题发生任何军事对抗，美国应该从战略模糊转向明确的不干预政策。” 国际危机组织驻台湾安全分析师杨威廉告诉德国之声，报告中点名的国家尚未对该智库的提议发表正式评论，但其结论“将会令人震惊”。 杨说，鉴于国防优先基金会以其孤立主义外交和国防政策立场而闻名，并且据称与白宫许多高级和志同道合的决策者有联系，这种担忧将会更加严重。 杨指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁称，如果他在双边关系其他领域提出的更多付款或让步的要求得不到满足，他将从欧洲和亚洲盟国撤军。

reflection.en: A report from the Defense Priorities Foundation suggests a significant shift in US defense strategy, advocating for a pullback from the western Pacific and the termination of key alliances. This proposal, intended to re-evaluate commitments, has understandably alarmed long-standing allies who rely on these security arrangements. The situation underscores...
reflection.zh: 国防优先基金会的一份报告建议美国国防战略发生重大转变，主张从西太平洋撤军并终止关键联盟。这项旨在重新评估承诺的提议，可以理解地引起了那些依赖这些安全安排的长期盟友的警惕。这一局势凸显了在考虑影响全球稳定和信任的重大政策变革时，审慎权衡和明智咨询的至关重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: China tightens travel rules over tech security
title.zh: 中国收紧旅行规定以保障科技安全

summary.en: Beijing has implemented new travel restrictions, including exit bans for individuals deemed to have endangered China's "industrial or technological security." These rules, particularly relevant to artificial intelligence and technology import/export violations, aim to protect national sovereignty, security, and...
summary.zh: 北京实施了新的旅行限制，包括对被认为危害中国“工业或技术安全”的个人实施出境禁令。这些规定尤其针对人工智能以及技术进出口违规行为，旨在保护国家主权、安全和发展利益，并可能影响外国及台湾国民。

body.en:
Beijing says the new rules, which could also apply to foreign and Taiwanese nationals, are aimed at safeguarding "national security."

Sweeping travel restrictions on Chinese citizens came into effect on Tuesday, including exit bans for people considered to have endangered China 's "industrial or technological security."

The new exit-and-entry rules, which were passed in July, apply to citizens deemed to have violated technology import and export regulations, particularly in the field of artificial intelligence .

The State Council in Beijing said the new rules were formulated to "safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests."

The regulations apply not only to people within China but also to Chinese citizens deemed to have committed criminal acts abroad.

In such cases, citizens could be "prohibited from leaving the country for a period of six months to three years from the date of their return to China," said the State Council.

The restrictions come as China remains locked in a technological arms race with the United States , with both countries accusing each other of stealing locally developed AI models in recent months.

And analysts warn that the full scope of the new rules will only become clear once they start being implemented.

Security and criminal activities "can be vaguely defined and easily adjusted," said Chong Ja Ian, an analyst from the National University of Singapore , telling the AFP news agency that Beijing has given itself a "wide remit."

Under the new regulations, foreign nationals could also be denied entry to China for up to five years if found to have made false statements in ​visa applications.

Foreign governments have often reported instances of citizens being denied permission to leave China due ⁠to security-related ​investigations.

Analyst Chong highlighted the recent case of US citizen Min Zin who the US government said was detained improperly in Yunnan province in June.

"The case of Min Zin is a reminder that the range of people [that Beijing] could restrict from exiting could be quite wide – and potentially arbitrary," he said.

The new rules could have particular implications for Taiwanese nationals who work in the tech sector and who travel between Taiwan and China .

Authorities in Taipei have warned citizens to take extra care on visits to China, which considers people from Taiwan to be Chinese citizens.

Beijing has dismissed any such concerns, claiming the rules provide better legal protection for Taiwanese.

Dylan Loh, an associate professor at Singapore's Nanyang Technological University, told AFP the travel restrictions "send a message" that China will take action to prevent "leaks in security or national interest-sensitive areas."

If you rely on our team for trusted...
body.zh: 北京表示，新规定也可能适用于外国人和台湾公民，旨在维护“国家安全”。 对中国公民的全面旅行限制于周二生效，包括对被认为危及中国“工业或技术安全”的人实施出境禁令。 7月份通过的新出入境规定适用于被视为违反技术进出口规定的公民，特别是在人工智能领域。 北京国务院表示，制定新规定是为了“维护国家主权、安全、发展利益”。 该规定不仅适用于中国境内的人，也适用于被认为在国外有犯罪行为的中国公民。 国务院表示，在这种情况下，公民可能“自返回中国之日起六个月至三年内禁止出境”。 这些限制出台之际，中国仍陷入与美国的技术军备竞赛，近几个月来两国互相指责对方窃取当地开发的人工智能模型。 分析人士警告说，新规则的全部范围只有在开始实施后才会变得清晰。 新加坡国立大学分析师庄嘉伊恩 (Chong Ja Ian) 告诉法新社，安全和犯罪活动“可以被模糊地定义，并且很容易调整”。他告诉法新社，北京方面已经赋予了自己“广泛的职权范围”。 根据新规定，如果发现在签证申请中提供虚假陈述，外国人也可能被拒绝进入中国，最长可达五年。 外国政府经常报告公民因安全相关调查而被拒绝离开中国的情况。 分析师 Chong 重点介绍了最近发生的美国公民敏津的案件，美国政府称其于 6 月在云南省被不当拘留。 “敏津的案例提醒我们，（北京）可以限制退出的人群范围可能相当广泛，而且可能是任意的，”他说。 新规定可能对在科技行业工作以及在台湾和中国大陆之间旅行的台湾国民产生特别影响。 台北当局警告公民前往中国大陆时要格外小心，中国将台湾人视为中国公民。 北京方面否认了任何此类担忧，声称这些规则为台湾人提供了更好的法律保护。 新加坡南洋理工大学副教授迪伦·卢告诉法新社，旅行限制“发出了一个信息”，即中国将采取行动防止“安全或国家利益敏感领域的泄密”。 如果您信赖我们的团队值得信赖...

reflection.en: The implementation of sweeping travel restrictions and exit bans in China, justified under the banner of national security, raises concerns about the potential for unchecked state power. Proverbs 28:15 warns that "when the wicked rule, people groan," highlighting the human cost when security measures become oppressive.
reflection.zh: 中国以国家安全为由实施广泛的旅行限制和出境禁令，这引发了对国家权力不受制约的担忧。《箴言》28章15节警告说：“恶人掌权，人民就叹息。”这句经文强调了当安全措施变得压迫性时，所带来的巨大的人类代价。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: ‘This is seriously bold’: How China turned Taiwan tensions into a top-rating TV spy drama
title.zh: “这真是大胆”：中国如何将台湾紧张局势变成一部收视率飙升的电视间谍剧

summary.en: A new Chinese spy drama, 'Long Watch' (Jiaofeng), co-produced by the Ministry of State Security, has become a hit across the Taiwan Strait. The show, which fictionalizes real-life crises, follows a double agent working for China whose cover is blown. While dismissed as propaganda in Taiwan, the series' success...
summary.zh: 一部由国家安全部联合制作的中国新间谍剧《交锋》（Jiaofeng）已成为海峡两岸的热门剧集。该剧将现实生活中的危机虚构化，讲述了一名在中国大陆秘密工作的双面间谍被揭穿的故事。尽管在台湾被斥为宣传片，但该剧的成功凸显了娱乐媒体在处理敏感政治话题方面的作用。

body.en: Dismissed in Taiwan as simply propaganda, the Long Watch, or Jiaofeng, has proved a sensation across the strait with its references to real-life crises After shaking off the people trailing her through a crowded market and emerging from a bathroom in disguise, the double agent appears to have escaped. But a sip of water on a plane eventually gets her. She is poisoned after Taiwan’s military intelligence service discovers that she has been working secretly for China. The plot comes from a new Chinese spy drama co-produced by the Ministry of State Security. Since its premiere on 6 September, it has become a TV hit, with a fictionalised take on a subject rarely treated so directly: the modern history of tensions with Taiwan. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在台湾，《长守》或《叫风》被认为只是宣传品，但它却因提及现实生活中的危机而轰动了海峡两岸。在摆脱了跟踪她的人穿过拥挤的市场，乔装打扮地从浴室里出来后，这位双重间谍似乎已经逃脱了。但飞机上的一小口水最终让她崩溃了。台湾军事情报部门发现她一直在为中国大陆秘密工作后，她被毒死。剧情来自于国家安全部联合制作的一部新的中国谍战剧。自 9 月 6 日首播以来，它已成为电视热门节目，以虚构的方式讲述了一个很少如此直接处理的主题：与台湾紧张关系的现代历史。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This drama, 'Long Watch,' produced with the involvement of China's Ministry of State Security, uses fictionalized events to explore cross-strait tensions. It raises questions about how narratives are shaped and disseminated through popular media, reminding us of the importance of discerning truth from fiction, as Ephesians 4:25 urges us to speak truthfully...
reflection.zh: 这部由中国国家安全部参与制作的《交锋》剧集，通过虚构的情节来探讨海峡两岸的紧张局势。它引发了关于叙事如何通过大众媒体塑造和传播的疑问，提醒我们要分辨真伪，正如以弗所书4章25节所劝勉的，要说诚实话。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，因间谍头子警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: Beijing has responded to calls for the US to hinder China's AI industry, dismissing them as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief expressed concerns that the advancement of artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the rule of the Communist party.
summary.zh: 北京方面驳斥了要求美国阻碍中国人工智能产业发展的呼吁，称其为‘危言耸听’。与此同时，中国最高情报官员警告称，人工智能的不断发展可能威胁到共产党统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented capabilities, prompting both excitement and apprehension. As nations and leaders grapple with its potential, the ancient story of Babel reminds us that unchecked ambition, even in pursuit of knowledge or power, can lead to unintended consequences and division.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展为人类带来了前所未有的能力，既引发了兴奋，也带来了忧虑。当国家和领导人都在努力应对其潜力时，古老的巴别塔故事提醒我们，即使是在追求知识或权力的过程中，不受约束的野心也可能导致意想不到的后果和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011. Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国呼吁结束英语核心地位引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers, and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.
summary.zh: 在中国学校降低英语地位的呼吁正在引发关于其对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The debate in China about the role of English in education touches on how societies navigate the explosion of knowledge and global communication. As Professor Tang Jiafeng questions English's dominance, it mirrors the broader challenge of discerning which knowledge serves us best in an era of unprecedented information growth, as described in Daniel 12:4:...
reflection.zh: 在中国关于英语教育作用的辩论，触及了社会如何应对知识的爆炸式增长和全球交流。正如唐嘉风教授质疑英语的主导地位，这也反映了一个更广泛的挑战：在一个信息空前增长的时代，辨别哪些知识最能服务于我们。正如但以理书12:4所描述的：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。
