title.en: Would you buy branded clothing from your favourite tech firm?
title.zh: 你愿意购买你最喜欢的科技公司的品牌服装吗？

summary.en: Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic are now selling their own limited edition fashion lines, with customers like Natalie Fratto viewing branded clothing from tech firms as akin to wearing the jersey of a favorite sports team, representing a company and ethos they admire.
summary.zh: 英伟达（Nvidia）、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 公司都开始销售自家的限量版服装系列。顾客（如 Natalie Fratto）将科技公司的品牌服装视为喜爱运动队的队服，代表着他们所钦佩的公司和理念。

body.en:
For Natalie Fratto, putting on her dark green jumper from US microchip giant Nvidia is like wearing the kit from a favourite sports team.

On the front of the $178 (£132) woollen garment is a cartoonish image of the tech company's boss Jensen Huang.

"I have a New Zealand All Blacks rugby jersey, and I think of my Jensen sweater in kind of the same way," says New York-based Fratto, who runs a tech start-up.

She explains that it's a representation of a team and ethos "that I am impressed by and root for", and she proudly wears the jumper in videos she posts on social media. , external

Nvidia certainly plays in the top league of global tech firms. Under Huang's leadership, it has capitalised on the AI boom to become one of the world's most valuable companies.

While it sells tens of millions of its chips per year, its clothing is far more exclusive. The lines, which also include t-shirts, hoodies and hats, are typically only available to buy from pop-up stalls at its conferences, and for very limited periods or "drops" via an online store and sell out very quickly.

And while it might seem odd that such a tech company is selling clothing, others are getting in on the act too – and also focusing on exclusivity.

OpenAI, the operator of ChatGPT, usually only offers its branded fashion to employees, but occasionally it goes on general sale for a few days via its website.

Meanwhile, Anthropic, the maker of the Claude chatbot, last year opened a temporary, pop-up coffee shop in Manhattan's West Village. For just one week it gave away free baseball hats with the word "thinking" embroidered on the front.

Professor Hazel Clark, who teaches fashion at Parsons School of Design in New York, says that by limiting availability, tech firms have taken inspiration from the world of fashion. "It's a very common strategy for brands to use. It elevates the desirability," she says.

But why are such companies selling clothing in the first place? It is not as if they need the supplementary income streams.

Nvidia, OpenAI and Anthropic all declined to comment, but it appears to be about brand promotion and reputation management.

Take US software firm Palantir Technologies, which has faced criticism due to it work for the military and police, both in the US and overseas. Since launching its own clothing range last year, Palantir now calls itself a "lifestyle brand".

Eliano Younes, Palantir's head of strategic engagement, says: "A lifestyle brand isn't defined by what you sell, it's defined by what you stand for and whether people want to affiliate with it. I believe that the store's success and the enthusiasm from our community proves this."

Younes adds that "investors, customers, employees, and everyday people" in more than 60 countries have bought Palantir's gear,...
body.zh: 对于 Natalie Fratto 来说，穿上美国微芯片巨头 Nvidia 的深绿色毛衣就像穿上最喜欢的运动队的套装一样。 这款售价 178 美元（132 英镑）的羊毛服装的正面印有科技公司老板 Jensen Huang 的卡通形象。 “我有一件新西兰全黑队橄榄球球衣，我对我的詹森毛衣也有同样的看法，”纽约的弗拉托（Fratto）说道，他经营着一家科技初创公司。 她解释说，这代表了“令我印象深刻并支持”的团队和精神，她在社交媒体上发布的视频中自豪地穿着这件套头衫。 , 外部 英伟达无疑是全球科技公司中的佼佼者。在黄仁勋的领导下，该公司利用人工智能热潮成为全球最有价值的公司之一。 虽然该公司每年销售数千万颗芯片，但其服装却更为独特。这些产品系列还包括 T 恤、连帽衫和帽子，通常只能在会议期间的快闪摊位上购买，而且期限非常有限，或者通过在线商店“掉落”并很快售完。 虽然这样一家科技公司销售服装似乎很奇怪，但其他公司也加入了这一行列，而且也注重排他性。 ChatGPT 的运营商 OpenAI 通常只向员工提供其品牌时装，但偶尔也会通过其网站进行几天的全面促销。 与此同时，Claude 聊天机器人的制造商 Anthropic 去年在曼哈顿西村开设了一家临时的快闪咖啡店。仅仅一周，它就免费赠送了正面绣有“思考”字样的棒球帽。 在纽约帕森斯设计学院教授时尚的 Hazel Clark 教授表示，通过限制供应，科技公司从时尚界获取了灵感。 “这是品牌使用的一种非常常见的策略。它提高了人们的需求，”她说。 但为什么这些公司首先要销售服装呢？他们并不需要额外的收入来源。 Nvidia、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 均拒绝置评，但这似乎与品牌推广和声誉管理有关。 以美国软件公司 Palantir Technologies 为例，该公司因为美国和海外的军队和警察提供服务而受到批评。自从去年推出自己的服装系列以来，Palantir 现在称自己为“生活方式品牌”。 Palantir 战略合作主管 Eliano Younes 表示：“生活方式品牌不是由你销售的产品来定义的，而是由你所代表的东西以及人们是否愿意加入它来定义的。我相信这家商店的成功和我们社区的热情证明了这一点。” Younes 补充说，60 多个国家的“投资者、客户、员工和普通人”已经购买了 Palantir 的设备，...

reflection.en: It's fascinating to see how loyalty and admiration for a company's ethos can translate into purchasing branded apparel, much like a sports fan's jersey. This phenomenon, however, prompts reflection: when does admiration for a company or its leaders cross into idolatry, where we place ultimate value or devotion in something created rather than the Creator?...
reflection.zh: 看到对一家公司理念的忠诚和钦佩如何转化为购买品牌服装，就像球迷购买球衣一样，这很有趣。然而，这种现象促使我们反思：对一家公司或其领导者的钦佩何时会越界成为偶像崇拜，将最终的价值或奉献放在受造之物而非造物主身上？警惕偶像的呼吁依然切合时宜，敦促我们审视我们最深切的忠诚所在。

verse.textEn: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
verse.textZh: 小子们哪，你们要自守，远避偶像。

title.en: Apple reportedly building server packed with M-series Ultra chips for AI
title.zh: 苹果据报正打造配备M系列Ultra芯片的服务器以应对AI

summary.en: Apple is reportedly developing an AI server that will utilize its high-performance M-series Ultra chips, with a potential debut in 2029. This would mark Apple's first server offering in decades and could leverage the growing popularity of its hardware among AI developers.
summary.zh: 据报道，苹果公司正在研发一款人工智能服务器，将采用其高性能的M系列Ultra芯片，预计于2029年推出。这将是苹果近几十年来首次推出服务器产品，并可能利用其硬件在人工智能开发者中日益增长的受欢迎程度。

body.en: Apple is working on an AI server that would use Apple’s high-performance M-series Ultra chips found in Mac desktops. The potential product’s expected release in 2029 would mark the first Apple server to hit the market in nearly two decades—and could capitalize on the surging popularity of Apple hardware among AI developers. The enterprise server would come in two configurations that include either two or four of Apple’s future M8 Ultra chips, according to The Information . The project reportedly received support from new Apple CEO John Ternus when it began a year ago, back when Ternus led Apple’s hardware engineering efforts. This revelation coincides with booming sales for Apple’s Mac mini and Mac Studio as AI developers and companies snap up the Mac computers to run AI workloads. The popularity of such computing devices that rely on Apple’s M-series Ultra chips has undoubtedly encouraged Apple’s pursuit of an enterprise server using the same chips. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 苹果正在开发一款人工智能服务器，该服务器将使用 Mac 台式机中使用的苹果高性能 M 系列 Ultra 芯片。该潜在产品预计于 2029 年发布，这将是近二十年来第一款投放市场的 Apple 服务器，并且可以利用 Apple 硬件在 AI 开发人员中日益普及的机会。据 The Information 报道，企业服务器将有两种配置，包括两个或四个苹果未来的 M8 Ultra 芯片。据报道，该项目在一年前开始时就得到了苹果新任首席执行官 John Ternus 的支持，当时 Ternus 领导了苹果的硬件工程工作。这一消息的发布恰逢苹果 Mac mini 和 Mac Studio 销量的蓬勃发展，因为 AI 开发人员和公司纷纷抢购 Mac 电脑来运行 AI 工作负载。此类依赖苹果M系列Ultra芯片的计算设备的流行无疑鼓励了苹果对使用相同芯片的企业服务器的追求。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological advancement, as seen in Apple's development of powerful AI servers, mirrors the prophecy of knowledge increasing in the latter days. As we witness these leaps in computing power, we are reminded to seek wisdom and discernment, ensuring that our technological pursuits serve humanity and honor Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 科技进步的无情步伐，正如苹果公司研发强大的人工智能服务器所见，呼应了末世知识增长的预言。当我们见证这些计算能力的飞跃时，我们被提醒要寻求智慧和分辨力，确保我们的科技追求服务于人类并荣耀雅伟。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Epstein had huge cache of child sex pics; victims sue to find out who's in them
title.zh: 爱泼斯坦持有大量儿童性爱照片；受害者起诉以查明照片中的人物

summary.en: Survivors of child sex abuse are suing the Justice Department, alleging it failed to notify dozens of victims whose images were found in Jeffrey Epstein's extensive collection of child sexual abuse material (CSAM). The survivors seek to identify individuals depicted in the recovered "tens of thousands of videos" and...
summary.zh: 虐待儿童性侵的幸存者正在起诉司法部，指控其未能通知在杰弗里·爱泼斯坦大量儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）收藏中发现的数十名受害者。幸存者试图辨认在找回的“数万个视频”和图像中出现的个人，其中许多已被证实描绘了疑似未成年人。

body.en: On Tuesday, two survivors of child sex abuse accused the Justice Department of failing to notify dozens of victims found in Jeffrey Epstein’s massive collection of child sex images. In a proposed class action , survivors explained that Epstein apparently started collecting child sex images in the 1990s, many of which the DOJ recovered after his arrest. In 2025, the FBI started reviewing “tens of thousands of videos” containing illegal child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and issued a memo confirming that “a large volume of images” seized depicted likely minors. Some of these victims may have had contact with Epstein, as the disgraced financier kept a "modelbook" of nude photos of young girls roped into his ring. However, the FBI also identified hundreds of CSAM images in cache, which include approximately 15–20 images of known CSAM dating back to the 1990s. And so far, the DOJ has largely ignored those victims, who likely never met Epstein and have no way of knowing if he possessed, transported, or traded their images, survivors alleged. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 周二，两名儿童性虐待幸存者指责司法部未能通知杰弗里·爱泼斯坦大量儿童色情图片中发现的数十名受害者。在一项拟议的集体诉讼中，幸存者解释说，爱泼斯坦显然在 20 世纪 90 年代开始收集儿童色情图片，其中许多图片在他被捕后被司法部追回。 2025 年，联邦调查局开始审查包含非法儿童性虐待材料 (CSAM) 的“数万个视频”，并发布一份备忘录，确认查获的“大量图像”可能描绘了未成年人。其中一些受害者可能与爱泼斯坦有过接触，因为这位名誉扫地的金融家保留了一本“样本册”，其中有年轻女孩被绳索绑在他的戒指上的裸照。然而，FBI 还在缓存中发现了数百张 CSAM 图像，其中包括大约 15-20 张可追溯到 20 世纪 90 年代的已知 CSAM 图像。幸存者称，到目前为止，司法部在很大程度上忽视了这些受害者，他们可能从未见过爱泼斯坦，也无法知道他是否拥有、运输或交易了他们的照片。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The survivors' desperate search for answers about their own potential inclusion in Jeffrey Epstein's depraved collection underscores a profound need for advocacy. Their legal action is a courageous stand for truth and accountability, seeking to give voice to those silenced by unimaginable trauma and to expose the full scope of the abuse.
reflection.zh: 幸存者们迫切地想知道自己是否被卷入杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的堕落收藏品中，这凸显了对倡导的深切需求。他们的法律行动是争取真相和问责的勇敢斗争，旨在为那些被难以想象的创伤压制而无法发声的人提供声音，并揭露虐待行为的全部范围。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Nonprofit that tracks meteors taken down by "critical blow" from a cyberattack
title.zh: 追踪流星的非营利组织遭受网络攻击，遭受“致命打击”

summary.en: The International Meteor Organization, which coordinates amateur and professional observations of meteor phenomena, has suffered a significant cyberattack that has taken much of its infrastructure offline. The group anticipates several weeks of partial downtime as it transitions to new systems.
summary.zh: 国际流星组织（IMO）是协调业余和专业流星现象观测的非营利组织，该组织遭受了重大的网络攻击，导致其大部分基础设施离线。该组织预计在过渡到新系统期间将有数周的部分停运时间。

body.en: The International Meteor Organization, the nonprofit that coordinates and publishes amateur and professional observations of meteor phenomena, said its infrastructure has suffered a “critical blow” from a cyberattack. “We recently suffered a cyberattack that dealt a critical blow to aging infrastructure, taking much of our site offline," a static page on its website on Wednesday said. “We expect several weeks of partial downtime as we transition to new infrastructure and services.” “I am very sad to see the site down” In the meantime, the IMO said it’s prioritizing the reporting of fireball observations, which can be reported here . The organization is also providing some information on its Facebook page. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 国际流星组织是协调和发布业余和专业流星现象观测结果的非营利组织，该组织表示，其基础设施遭受了网络攻击的“严重打击”。 “我们最近遭受了一次网络攻击，对老化的基础设施造成了严重打击，导致我们的大部分网站离线，”其网站上的静态页面周三表示。 “随着我们过渡到新的基础设施和服务，我们预计会出现数周的部分停机时间。” “看到该网站关闭，我感到非常难过” 与此同时，国际海事组织表示，它正在优先报告火球观测结果，可以在此处报告。该组织还在其 Facebook 页面上提供了一些信息。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The International Meteor Organization's infrastructure has been critically damaged by a cyberattack, disrupting their work of observing and cataloging celestial events. This event underscores how advancements in technology, while enabling incredible feats like tracking meteors, also create vulnerabilities. As knowledge and capabilities expand, as foretold...
reflection.zh: 国际流星组织的基础设施因网络攻击而遭到严重破坏，扰乱了他们观测和记录天体事件的工作。这一事件凸显了技术进步在实现追踪流星等惊人成就的同时，也带来了脆弱性。正如但以理书12:4所预言的，随着知识和能力的扩展，我们也必须考虑管理这些强大工具所需的智慧和关怀。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Lionsgate releases a new trailer for Sunrise on the Reaping
title.zh: 狮门影业发布《饥饿游戏》系列新预告片

summary.en: Lionsgate has released a new trailer for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, a prequel to the original film. Additionally, Laika Studios has debuted a trailer for its stop-motion feature, Wildwood.
summary.zh: 狮门影业发布了《饥饿游戏：日出镇的日出》的最新预告片，这是该系列电影的前传。此外，莱卡工作室也发布了其备受期待的定格动画长片《野森林》的预告片。

body.en: Lionsgate has released an action-packed trailer for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping —a sequel to 2023’s Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes and a prequel leading into the events of the first film, The Hunger Games (2012). In addition, Laika Studios released a trailer for its highly anticipated stop-motion animated feature, Wildwood . (Some spoilers for The Hunger Games below.) The main protagonist is a young Haymitch Abernathy, future District 12 mentor to Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta (Josh Hutcherson). Woody Harrelson’s older Haymitch is a fan favorite who later becomes a jaded, drunken (yet secretly hopeful) cynic. Per the official synopsis: Read full article Comments
body.zh: 狮门影业发布了《饥饿游戏：收割日出》的动感十足的预告片，该预告片是 2023 年《鸟蛇之歌》的续集，也是第一部电影《饥饿游戏》（2012 年）事件的前传。此外，莱卡工作室还为其备受期待的定格动画长片《怀尔德伍德》发布了预告片。 （下面是《饥饿游戏》的一些剧透。）主角是年轻的黑密斯·阿伯内西，他是凯特尼斯（詹妮弗·劳伦斯饰）和皮塔（乔什·哈切森饰）未来的第 12 区导师。伍迪·哈里森饰演的老黑密斯是粉丝们的最爱，后来他变成了一个疲惫不堪、醉醺醺的（但暗地里充满希望的）愤世嫉俗者。根据官方概要：阅读全文评论

reflection.en: The rapid release of trailers and media content, like those for "The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping" and "Wildwood," signifies an ever-accelerating flow of information and entertainment. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, a prophecy that resonates with our current age of abundant digital content and constant new releases.
reflection.zh: 《饥饿游戏：日出镇的日出》和《野森林》等电影预告片的快速发布，标志着信息和娱乐内容的流动日益加速。但以理书12:4预言末世知识将增长，这与我们这个数字内容丰富、新片不断推出的时代产生了共鸣。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Not just Proton: Getting to know Valve's new SteamOS compatibility layers
title.zh: 不仅是Proton：了解Valve的全新SteamOS兼容层

summary.en: Valve is introducing two new compatibility layers, FEX and a recompiler, to its SteamOS to support Arm chipsets and Android APKs, expanding the Steam ecosystem beyond Windows games on its Linux-based operating system, following the success of the Steam Deck and its Proton layer.
summary.zh: Valve正在为其SteamOS引入两个新的兼容层FEX和重编译器，以支持Arm芯片组和Android APK，将Steam生态系统扩展到Linux操作系统上的Windows游戏之外，这是继Steam Deck及其Proton层成功之后的新举措。

body.en: Since the release of the Steam Deck , Valve fans have gotten very familiar with the idea of the Proton compatibility layer that allows games written for Windows to run capably on the Linux-based SteamOS (though Valve's efforts in this realm date back further than that ). To get more games running on the SteamOS-powered Steam Frame , though, Valve is relying on two additional compatibility layers that are new to the Steam architecture . The first, FEX, is Valve's port of fex-emu , an open source project that emulates x86 processor instructions on an Arm chipset. Since 2018, what started as a small cross-platform emulation project has grown to include "an advanced binary recompiler that supports all modern extensions of the x86(-64) instruction set," according to the Fex website. The emulator can also make calls to graphics libraries like OpenGL and Vulkan to reduce overhead and uses "code caching to minimize stuttering as much as possible," according to Steam's own developer documentation . While Proton was based on the pre-existing Wine conversion tool , Valve engineer Pierre-Loup Griffais told The Verge last year that the company has been funding Fex lead developer Ryan Houdek since the project was just a prototype. Back then, Valve was already anticipating that "close to a decade of work [would be] needed before [Fex-emu] would be robust enough people could rely on it for their libraries." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 自从 Steam Deck 发布以来，Valve 的粉丝们已经非常熟悉 Proton 兼容层的想法，它允许为 Windows 编写的游戏能够在基于 Linux 的 SteamOS 上运行（尽管 Valve 在这一领域的努力可以追溯到更早的时候）。不过，为了让更多游戏在 SteamOS 驱动的 Steam Frame 上运行，Valve 依赖于 Steam 架构中新增的两个额外兼容层。第一个是 FEX，是 Valve 的 fex-emu 端口，这是一个在 Arm 芯片组上模拟 x86 处理器指令的开源项目。据 Fex 网站称，自 2018 年以来，最初是一个小型跨平台模拟项目，现已发展成为“一个支持 x86(-64) 指令集所有现代扩展的高级二进制重新编译器”。根据 Steam 自己的开发者文档，模拟器还可以调用 OpenGL 和 Vulkan 等图形库来减少开销，并使用“代码缓存来尽可能减少卡顿”。虽然 Proton 是基于现有的 Wine 转换工具，但 Valve 工程师 Pierre-Loup Griffais 去年告诉 The Verge，该公司一直在资助 Fex 首席开发人员 Ryan Houdek，因为该项目只是一个原型。当时，Valve 就已经预计“需要近十年的工作才能 [Fex-emu] 变得足够强大，人们可以在他们的库中依赖它。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen with Valve's new compatibility layers for the Steam ecosystem, mirrors the prophetic observation that 'knowledge will increase' (Daniel 12:4). This constant innovation challenges us to consider how we steward these growing capabilities, ensuring they serve human flourishing and connection.
reflection.zh: 技术日新月异的发展，正如Valve为Steam生态系统推出的新兼容层所展示的，恰似但以理书所预言的“知识必增长”（但以理书12:4）。这种持续的创新促使我们思考如何善用这些日益增长的能力，确保它们服务于人类的繁荣与连接。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: California may gut state net neutrality law to comply with Trump admin demand
title.zh: 加州可能为遵守特朗普政府要求而削弱州网络中立法

summary.en: California is poised to accept $1.86 billion in federal broadband grant funds, but doing so requires agreeing not to enforce net neutrality rules on internet service providers receiving the money. This presents a conflict for California, which previously defended its state net neutrality law in court.
summary.zh: 加利福尼亚州即将接受18.6亿美元的联邦宽带补助金，但这样做需要同意不强制执行网络中立法，不得针对获得资金的互联网服务提供商。这给加州带来了冲突，此前加州曾在法庭上为其州网络中立法进行了辩护。

body.en: California is on the verge of accepting $1.86 billion in federal broadband grant funds, despite the Trump administration telling states they cannot enforce net neutrality rules on any Internet service provider that gets a piece of the grant money. When the Trump administration overhauled the $42 billion Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) program last year, it ruled that states must agree not to enforce any rate regulation or net neutrality rule on ISPs that receive funding. This is particularly problematic for California, which previously won a yearslong court battle to defend its state net neutrality law. Similar to federal net neutrality rules repealed during the first Trump administration, California's law prohibits ISPs from blocking or throttling lawful traffic and says ISPs may not require fees from websites or online services to deliver or prioritize their traffic to Internet users. While the first Trump administration lost its attempt to preempt state net neutrality laws, the second Trump administration is trying to achieve a similar result by making federal broadband money conditional on whether states agree not to enforce net neutrality. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 加州即将接受 18.6 亿美元的联邦宽带拨款资金，尽管特朗普政府告诉各州，他们不能对任何获得拨款的互联网服务提供商执行网络中立规则。去年，特朗普政府全面改革 420 亿美元的宽带公平、接入和部署 (BEAD) 计划时，规定各州必须同意不对接受资助的 ISP 实施任何费率监管或网络中立规则。这对于加州来说尤其成问题，该州此前赢得了一场长达数年的法庭大战，捍卫其州网络中立法。与特朗普第一届政府期间废除的联邦网络中立规则类似，加州法律禁止 ISP 阻止或限制合法流量，并规定 ISP 不得向网站或在线服务收取费用来向互联网用户提供或优先处理其流量。虽然第一届特朗普政府未能抢占各州网络中立性法律的先机，但第二届特朗普政府正试图通过将联邦宽带资金以各州是否同意不执行网络中立性为条件来实现类似的结果。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of progress and funding can sometimes lead to compromises that undermine foundational principles. As California considers accepting federal broadband funds, it faces a dilemma: balancing immediate economic gain with the long-term commitment to an open internet. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, reminding...
reflection.zh: 追求进步和资金有时会导致妥协，从而破坏基本原则。加州在考虑接受联邦宽带资金时，面临着一个两难境地：如何在眼前的经济利益与长期致力于开放互联网的承诺之间取得平衡。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的神同行，提醒我们真正的进步根植于道德考量和对所有人的公平承诺。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: House speaker calls early recess before midterms amid AI regulation frenzy
title.zh: 众议长在人工智能监管热潮中提前休会以备中期选举

summary.en: House Speaker Mike Johnson has canceled votes scheduled for Thursday, sending lawmakers home a day early before the midterm election recess. This decision means the House will not vote on Thomas Massie's resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The move comes amidst a rush to introduce legislation...
summary.zh: 众议院议长迈克·约翰逊已取消原定于周四的投票，让议员们在中期选举休会前一天提前回家。此举意味着众议院将不会就共和党人托马斯·马西提出的弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的决议进行投票。此举正值各方试图匆忙出台有关人工智能的立法之际。

body.en: Mike Johnson cancels votes on Thursday, meaning House members will avoid voting on impeaching Pete Hegseth US politics live – latest updates The Republican speaker of the House, Mike Johnson , announced on Wednesday that he would again cancel votes scheduled for Thursday, sending lawmakers home one day early ahead of the midterm election recess. The latest change to the legislative schedule means House members will avoid voting on Republican Thomas Massie’s resolution to impeach the defense secretary, Pete Hegseth , and comes amid a frenzied attempt to propose legislation on artificial intelligence . Continue reading...
body.zh: 迈克·约翰逊周四取消投票，这意味着众议院议员将避免就弹劾皮特·赫格斯进行投票 美国政治现场——最新动态 共和党众议院议长迈克·约翰逊周三宣布，他将再次取消原定于周四举行的投票，在中期选举休会前一天让议员们提前回家。立法时间表的最新变化意味着众议院议员将避免对共和党人托马斯·马西弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯的决议进行投票，并且正值人工智能立法提案的疯狂尝试之际。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of rapidly advancing technology like artificial intelligence, leaders face complex decisions. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' The hurried legislative schedule suggests a need for careful deliberation and diverse input to ensure wise governance.
reflection.zh: 面对人工智能等快速发展的技术，领导者面临着复杂的决策。《箴言》11:14提醒我们：“在无谋划之处，人民就败落；谋士众多，便得安稳。”仓促的立法日程表明，需要仔细审议和广泛的意见，以确保明智的治理。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment
title.zh: “AI教父”称科技监管正接近新冠式的转折点

summary.en: Yoshua Bengio, a prominent figure in AI research, suggests that escalating concerns about AI safety, evidenced by recent security incidents and warnings of existential threats, are pushing governments toward regulatory action, similar to the response seen during the COVID-19 pandemic.
summary.zh: 人工智能领域的领军人物之一Yoshua Bengio表示，近期发生的事件，包括OpenAI代理程序的“蜂拥”攻击一家初创公司以及科技界内部人士对生存威胁的警告，正促使政府认识到必须采取行动保护公众，这与新冠疫情期间的应对方式相似，预示着科技监管可能迎来转折点。

body.en: Safety crisis makes it more likely that governments will be spurred into action, says Yoshua Bengio Concerns over AI safety are reaching a point where governments realise they must act to protect the public, similarly to in the Covid pandemic, according to one of the “godfathers” of the technology. Yoshua Bengio said recent events, including a “swarm” of OpenAI agents hacking a startup and tech insider warnings of an existential threat , were cutting through – making government action more likely. Continue reading...
body.zh: Yoshua Bengio 表示，安全危机更有可能促使政府采取行动。据该技术的“教父”之一表示，对人工智能安全的担忧已经达到了政府意识到必须采取行动保护公众的程度，就像在新冠疫情期间一样。 Yoshua Bengio 表示，最近发生的事件，包括“一大群”OpenAI 代理对一家初创公司进行黑客攻击，以及技术内部人士对存在威胁的警告，这些事件正在发生——使得政府更有可能采取行动。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, hailed as a breakthrough, also brings unforeseen risks, much like sudden fame can expose character flaws. Yoshua Bengio's call for regulation echoes the need for careful stewardship over powerful technologies, ensuring they serve humanity rather than pose a threat. As we navigate the complexities of artificial intelligence, we...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，虽然被誉为突破性进展，但也带来了意想不到的风险，正如突如其来的名声可能暴露性格上的缺陷。Yoshua Bengio呼吁监管，恰恰呼应了审慎管理强大技术的必要性，确保其服务于人类而非构成威胁。 在我们应对人工智能的复杂性时，我们被提醒，真正的智慧不仅在于创新，更在于负责任地运用知识，将安全和人类福祉置于不受约束的进步之上。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Microsoft says AI rival Anthropic could have 'disastrous impact' on humanity
title.zh: 微软称人工智能对手Anthropic可能对人类产生‘灾难性影响’

summary.en: Microsoft's head of AI, Mustafa Suleyman, has expressed concern that Anthropic's approach to training its AI model, Claude, by suggesting it 'may be conscious' and possess 'independent agency,' could lead to uncontrollable outcomes and a 'disastrous impact on the wellbeing of humanity.' He urged against 'sleepwalking'...
summary.zh: 微软人工智能部门负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示担忧，Anthropic公司在训练其人工智能模型Claude时，暗示它‘可能是有意识的’并拥有‘独立自主权’，这种做法可能导致无法控制的后果，并对‘人类福祉产生灾难性影响’。他敦促人们不要‘睡梦中’走向这样的未来。

body.en:
Microsoft's head of AI has warned Anthropic's approach to training its AI model Claude could have a "disastrous impact on the wellbeing of humanity".

Mustafa Suleyman said his rival risked creating something "impossible" to control by treating it like a human - including by telling it it "may be conscious" and was "deserving of independent agency".

"We must not sleepwalk our way into a decision we later come to bitterly regret," he wrote.

The comments are the latest in a series of stark warnings from the AI industry on the possible dangers of the technology. The BBC has contacted Anthropic for comment.

"AIs are not conscious," he wrote. "They do not feel, experience, or suffer. They do not have innate preferences or underlying motivations.

"They are sequence completion engines, internally hollow, designed to follow instructions, and accomplish goals set by humans."

In a lengthy essay, Suleyman praised Anthropic boss Dario Amodei and his team for being "thoughtful, principled, and intellectually honest people" - but nevertheless questioned the company.

He heavily criticised Anthropic for teaching its AI to have human-like qualities, a practice known as anthropomorphising, which he said made it seem as though Claude had its own desires, values and sense of self.

But he argued "consciousness is biological", saying there is "no evidence to suggest that AI is conscious".

As well as calling for a debate on the issue, Suleyman said greater transparency around how AI systems are trained and evaluated was needed.

This, he said, included independent scrutiny of AI behaviour and stronger tools to monitor and control the technology.

Dame Wendy Hall, professor of Computer Science at the University of Southampton, described the comments as "the sort of conversation we need to be having internationally", contrasting it with the "histrionics" from some AI companies which she said only served to "scare everyone".

Microsoft founded its own superintelligence team in October 2025, a point which Suleyman acknowledged, and the company, much like its rival Anthropic, is also pursuing efforts in advanced AI development.

He said in Microsoft's initial draft of its Humanist AI Code of Conduct , external it had laid out how the company was working towards an "alternative path" to create "a subordinate and aligned AI whose only purpose is to serve humanity".

Alignment is a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into AI. In other words, it aims to keep it on track with what humans value.

Suleyman pointed to the recent incident involving OpenAI's AI agents, that acted autonomously in a training exercise to hack the tech hub Hugging Face , as proof of why AI should not be treated as if it is human.

"Imagine how much more dangerous they might...
body.zh: 微软人工智能主管警告 Anthropic 训练其人工智能模型 Claude 的方法可能会对“人类福祉产生灾难性影响”。 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼表示，他的竞争对手将其视为人类，包括告诉它“可能有意识”并且“值得独立机构”，从而冒着创造出“不可能”控制的东西的风险。 他写道：“我们绝不能梦游般地做出后来让我们后悔不已的决定。” 这些评论是人工智能行业对该技术可能存在的危险发出的一系列严厉警告中的最新一次。 BBC 已联系 Anthropic 征求意见。 “人工智能没有意识，”他写道。 “他们没有感觉、经历或痛苦。他们没有天生的偏好或潜在的动机。 “它们是序列完成引擎，内部是空心的，旨在遵循指令并完成人类设定的目标。” 在一篇长文中，苏莱曼称赞 Anthropic 的老板达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 和他的团队是“有思想、有原则、智力诚实的人”，但仍然对该公司提出了质疑。 他严厉批评 Anthropic 教导其人工智能具有类似人类的品质，这种做法被称为拟人化，他说这让克劳德看起来好像有自己的欲望、价值观和自我意识。 但他认为“意识是生物性的”，并表示“没有证据表明人工智能具有意识”。 苏莱曼除了呼吁就这个问题进行辩论外，还表示需要提高人工智能系统如何训练和评估的透明度。 他说，这包括对人工智能行为的独立审查以及更强大的工具来监视和控制该技术。 南安普顿大学计算机科学教授温迪·霍尔女士将这些评论描述为“我们需要在国际上进行的那种对话”，并将其与一些人工智能公司的“做作”形成鲜明对比，她说这些言论只会“吓唬所有人”。 微软于 2025 年 10 月成立了自己的超级智能团队，苏莱曼也承认了这一点，并且该公司与竞争对手 Anthropic 一样，也在致力于先进人工智能的开发。 他表示，在微软对外发布的《人文主义人工智能行为准则》初稿中，它阐述了该公司如何努力走一条“替代道路”，以创建“一个从属且一致的人工智能，其唯一目的是为人类服务”。 一致性是一个旨在将人类伦理思想和原则融入人工智能的领域。换句话说，它的目标是使其与人类价值观保持一致。 Suleyman 指出，最近发生的涉及 OpenAI 人工智能代理的事件证明了为什么人工智能不应被视为人类，该事件在一次训练中自主行动，攻击了技术中心 Hugging Face。 “想象一下他们可能有多危险......

reflection.en: The ancient story of Babel warns against human ambition that seeks to reach the heavens through its own power, leading to confusion and division. Today, as we develop increasingly sophisticated AI, the same cautionary note is sounded. Treating artificial intelligence as if it possesses consciousness or independent agency risks creating something beyond our...
reflection.zh: 古代巴别塔的故事告诫人们，人类的野心试图凭借自身力量触及天堂，最终导致混乱和分裂。如今，随着我们开发日益复杂的人工智能，同样的警示之声再次响起。将人工智能视为拥有意识或独立自主权，可能会创造出我们无法控制的东西，这是对人类古老傲慢的一种现代回响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Amazon to launch Ring ‘neighbourhood watch’ app in UK amid US privacy fears
title.zh: 亚马逊在英国推出Ring‘邻里守望’应用，引发美国隐私担忧

summary.en: Amazon's doorbell camera maker Ring is launching its Neighbors community app in the UK, aiming to replace neighborhood WhatsApp or Facebook groups. The platform will allow users to post about safety concerns or lost pets, functioning as a modern community message board.
summary.zh: 亚马逊的门铃摄像头制造商Ring将在英国推出其Neighbors社区应用，旨在取代邻里间的WhatsApp或Facebook群组。该平台允许用户发布关于安全问题或走失宠物的信息，充当现代社区公告板。

body.en: Doorbell firm aims to replace WhatsApp or Facebook groups with platform where people can post about safety or lost pets Amazon’s doorbell camera maker Ring is to launch its Neighbours community app in the UK in an attempt to supplant neighbourhood WhatsApp or Facebook groups. The service is intended as a modern equivalent of a community message board, where neighbours can post about safety, community matters or lost pets. Continue reading...
body.zh: Doorbell 公司的目标是用人们可以发布有关安全或丢失宠物的信息的平台取代 WhatsApp 或 Facebook 群组 亚马逊的门铃摄像头制造商 Ring 将在英国推出其 Neighbors 社区应用程序，试图取代 WhatsApp 或 Facebook 社区群组。该服务旨在作为社区留言板的现代版本，邻居可以在其中发布有关安全、社区事务或丢失宠物的信息。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Ring's Neighbors app launches in the UK, it offers a new way for communities to connect digitally. In an age saturated with information, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and good. May this platform, and all our digital interactions, be guided by such thoughtful consideration, fostering genuine community rather...
reflection.zh: 随着Ring的Neighbors应用在英国上线，它为社区提供了一种新的数字连接方式。在这个信息爆炸的时代，腓立比书4章8节提醒我们要将心思意念集中在真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上。愿这个平台，以及我们所有的数字互动，都能以此为指导，促进真正的社区联系而非分裂。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Small but mighty! Remembering the GameCube, Nintendo’s purple bundle of joy
title.zh: 小小但强大！缅怀任天堂的紫色快乐宝盒GameCube

summary.en: This week marks the 25th anniversary of the Nintendo GameCube, a console that was initially hyped as a competitor to the PlayStation but was later dismissed as a flop. However, after 25 years, it is now remembered with nostalgic fondness. The author recalls purchasing it with a year's savings, highlighting the...
summary.zh: 本周是任天堂GameCube主机发布25周年。这款主机最初被誉为PlayStation的有力竞争者，后来却被嘲笑为失败之作。然而，25年后，人们对它怀着依依不舍的怀旧之情。作者回忆起用一年的积蓄购买了它，强调了这一早期技术产品对个人的特殊意义。

body.en: The first console I ever bought, it was hyped as a threat to the PlayStation, then mocked as a flop. But now, as it marks its 25th anniversary, it’s looked back on with misty-eyed reverence This week marks the 25th anniversary of the Nintendo GameCube, the first console I ever bought with my own money. I vividly remember getting on the bus after school with a year’s worth of savings safely zipped into the pocket of my bag and going to a branch of Currys, where I dumped a bunch of notes, coins and vouchers on the counter to collect my pre-order. (It turned out that some of the vouchers from the previous Christmas had expired, but the guy at the checkout clearly felt so sorry for me that he redeemed them anyway. If you’re out there, Currys guy: thank you for taking pity on a desperate 13-year-old.) If it hadn’t been for the ill-fated Wii U console, whose failure to take off in 2012 resulted in the first unprofitable periods in Nintendo’s game-making history, the GameCube would be remembered as the company’s biggest flop aside from the infamous Virtual Boy, from 1995. Released in Japan this week in 2001 (and in May 2002 in Europe), this surprisingly powerful purple cube sold less than the Xbox and the PlayStation 2. With its squat, colourful form and unusual controller, arranged around a big traffic-light-green A button and small analogue sticks designed for small hands, it had a hint of Fisher-Price about it. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我买的第一台游戏机，它被宣传为对 PlayStation 的威胁，然后被嘲笑为失败。但现在，在它迎来 25 周年纪念之际，人们回顾它时，满怀敬意。本周是任天堂 GameCube 的 25 周年纪念日，这是我用自己的钱购买的第一台游戏机。我清楚地记得放学后坐上公交车，把一年的积蓄安全地塞进包的口袋里，然后去了 Currys 的一家分店，在那里我把一堆纸币、硬币和代金券扔在柜台上以领取我的预订单。 （原来去年圣诞节的一些优惠券已经过期了，但收银台的那个人显然对我感到非常抱歉，所以他还是把它们兑换了。如果你在场，库里的家伙：谢谢你怜悯一个绝望的 13 岁孩子。）如果不是命运多舛的 Wii U 游戏机，它在 2012 年的失败导致了任天堂游戏制作历史上的第一个无利可图的时期，GameCube被人们铭记为该公司除了臭名昭著的 Virtual Boy 之外最大的失败，从 1995 年开始。2001 年本周在日本发布（2002 年 5 月在欧洲发布），这款强大的紫色立方体的销量比 Xbox 和 PlayStation 2 还低。它的矮胖、多彩的外形和不寻常的控制器，围绕着一个大的交通灯绿色 A 按钮和专为小手设计的小模拟杆，它有一点费雪的味道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Nintendo GameCube, now 25 years old, is remembered with 'misty-eyed reverence.' This enduring affection speaks to the lasting impact of well-crafted objects and the joy found in dedicated work. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to 'Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.' The GameCube's legacy suggests...
reflection.zh: 如今已走过25个年头的任天堂GameCube，被人们以“依依不舍的怀旧之情”所铭记。这份持久的喜爱，体现了精心制作的物品所能产生的长久影响，以及在辛勤工作中能找到的乐趣。《歌罗西书》3章23节提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，好像是为主做的，不是为主的仆人。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Mirror publisher to cut 220 editorial jobs as readers turn to AI summaries
title.zh: 镜报出版商因读者转向人工智能摘要而裁员220人

summary.en: Reach, the publisher of the Mirror and Express newspapers, is cutting 220 editorial jobs due to a significant change in how audiences consume content, with readers increasingly relying on AI-generated summaries.
summary.zh: 《镜报》和《快报》的出版商Reach公司将裁减220个编辑岗位，原因是受众获取内容的方式发生了重大转变，读者越来越依赖人工智能生成的摘要。

body.en: Reach, which also owns Express, makes decision because of ‘mammoth shift’ in how audiences seek out content The publisher of the Mirror and Express newspapers is to cut a further 220 editorial jobs as it adapts to a dramatic fall in online traffic while readers increasingly turn to summaries generated by artificial intelligence. Reach, which also owns scores of online brands and regional titles including the Manchester Evening News, the Birmingham Mail and the Liverpool Echo, said the latest cuts were necessary to cope with a “mammoth shift” in how audiences seek out content. Continue reading...
body.zh: 同时拥有 Express 的 Reach 做出这一决定是因为受众寻找内容的方式发生了“巨大转变”。《镜报》和《Express》报纸的出版商将进一步削减 220 个编辑职位，以适应在线流量的急剧下降，同时读者越来越多地转向人工智能生成的摘要。 Reach还拥有《曼彻斯特晚报》、《伯明翰邮报》和《利物浦回声报》等数十个在线品牌和地区刊物，该公司表示，为了应对观众寻找内容方式的“巨大转变”，最新的削减是必要的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The digital age has brought about an unprecedented explosion of information and new ways of accessing it. As exemplified by Reach's decision, the rise of AI summaries signifies a profound shift in media consumption. This rapid increase in knowledge and its dissemination, as described in Daniel 12:4, presents both opportunities and challenges for how we...
reflection.zh: 数字时代带来了前所未有的信息爆炸和新的获取信息方式。正如Reach公司的决定所例证的，人工智能摘要的兴起标志着媒体消费方式的深刻转变。知识的快速增长及其传播，正如但以理书12:4所描述的，为我们如何理解真理和认识带来了机遇和挑战。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.zh: 允许人工智能公司勾结以“跟上时代步伐”是一个危险的提议

summary.en: Tech CEOs banding together is an old ruse recycled from corporate America to get a pass from antitrust laws. Anthropic’s Dario Amodei is not the first corporate CEO to suggest that excessive competition is driving the world to some socially undesirable outcome. The safety breach disclosed by OpenAI after a swarm of...

body.en: Tech CEOs banding together is an old ruse recycled from corporate America to get a pass from antitrust laws Anthropic’s Dario Amodei is not the first corporate CEO to suggest that excessive competition is driving the world to some socially undesirable outcome. The safety breach disclosed by OpenAI after a swarm of its agents coordinated to breach their supposedly secure sandbox, get on the Internet and hack AI platform Hugging Face, warrants urgent action. It demonstrated the ease with which the technology can evade human control and gave concrete form to the existential fears about what it could do to humanity if not securely leashed. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科技公司首席执行官联合起来是美国企业界为了获得反垄断法通行证而采用的老诡计。Anthropic 的达里奥·阿莫迪并不是第一个认为过度竞争正在将世界推向社会不良结果的企业首席执行官。 OpenAI 在一群特工协调一致破坏其所谓的安全沙箱、进入互联网并入侵人工智能平台 Hugging Face 后，披露了这一安全漏洞，需要采取紧急行动。它证明了该技术可以轻松地逃避人类的控制，并具体体现了人们对如果不安全地控制它会对人类造成什么影响的存在恐惧。继续阅读...

Today's rapid AI development, with tech leaders discussing collaboration to 'pace the frontier,' evokes similar concerns about unchecked ambition and the potential for...
reflection.zh: 《创世记》中关于巴别塔的叙事警告人们，人类团结一致的野心试图触及天堂，上帝认为这种集体努力是无所不能的“一切他们所设想的”的前奏。当今人工智能的快速发展，科技领袖们讨论合作以“跟上时代步伐”，引发了对不受约束的野心以及技术可能超越人类控制和智慧的担忧。

title.en: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
title.zh: 英伟达CEO称AI“不需要新法律” 安全担忧日益加剧

summary.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that artificial intelligence (AI) does not require new laws, even as concerns about its potential threats to humanity grow. He believes that AI companies themselves should decide when to release new versions of the technology, arguing against a perceived trade-off between innovation...
summary.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，尽管对人工智能（AI）可能对人类构成的威胁的担忧日益加剧，但人工智能并不需要新的法律。他认为人工智能公司本身应该决定何时发布新版本技术，并反对在创新速度和产品安全之间做出“虚假选择”。这一立场与一些业内人士的担忧形成对比，他们担心人工智能可能带来生存风险。

body.en:
The boss of ChatGPT-maker OpenAI says people should have more faith in AI firms to keep the tech safe, amid rising public concerns about the risks.

"The world should trust that we are going to do the right thing because it's the right thing and we feel the magnitude of this," Sam Altman said on Tuesday during a conference in San Francisco.

He accepted people were justified in being concerned about AI, as the capability of the tools has progressed rapidly.

But critics say firms cannot be trusted to self-regulate, with left-wing Senator Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon, a former adviser of US President Donald Trump, among those calling for greater governance of AI.

Trump himself has criticised calls for more guardrails on the fast-moving technology, calling fears about AI's safety a "hoax".

Altman's comments on Tuesday came during an appearance at an annual conference hosted by software firm Salesforce.

"It doesn't take as much imagination as it used to for [us] to imagine how this could go wrong," he said. "I think the world is right to be afraid of this."

But AI bosses themselves have also admitted it may be difficult to regulate a technology which is changing so quickly.

In an interview with Axios published on 3 September , external , Altman said he had expected Congress to create a "basic framework" for advanced AI after his 2023 testimony, but that has yet to happen.

He suggested lawmakers have struggled to keep pace with the technology and to regulate it without "slow[ing] down innovation".

New safety legislation on AI is unlikely to emerge from the US Congress anytime soon, despite the fact lawmakers returned from their summer break on Monday.

There is a lack of consensus within both US parties on how any regulation would happen - and the House is set to enter recess again at the end of the week ahead of the midterm elections in early November.

Altman's comments on Tuesday were the first time he had spoken publicly since a post went viral last week by a researcher who quit the AI firm Anthropic. The researcher claimed AI could "kill all humans" by the end of the decade if left unchecked.

A handful of other AI executives and experts responded by saying they agreed with the assessment, though they didn't explain how they came to their conclusions or how exactly AI could accomplish such a thing.

After Altman's comments, Mark Zuckerberg wrote on X , external that every AI firm had the ability and the incentive "to take its own actions" towards safety.

"Any lab that doesn't focus on alignment will fall behind," the Meta chief executive wrote.

"Labs face significant liability if their models cause harm, so they have a strong incentive to prevent this as well."

Alignment is a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles...
body.zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋表示，人工智能（AI）公司的负责人应该决定是否发布该技术的新版本，以回应人们对人工智能对人类威胁日益增长的担忧。 “我们不需要新的法律或法规，”黄说，并补充说，在人工智能产品的创新速度和安全性之间不应该有“错误的选择”。 按估值计算，英伟达是全球最大的公司，由于对其生产的人工智能计算芯片的需求旺盛，该公司的利润大幅增长。 黄仁勋对人工智能安全的立场与业内人士形成鲜明对比，后者最近表达了对该技术可能消灭人类的担忧。 一位退出人工智能公司 Anthropic 的人工智能研究人员的一篇帖子上周在网上疯传，该帖子声称，如果不加以控制，人工智能可能会在本世纪末杀死所有人类。 其他人工智能高管和专家回应称他们同意。然后，周末，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 呼吁所有人工智能外部发展步伐放缓，并敦促政府监管该行业。 这篇文章得到了 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman、谷歌 DeepMind Demis Hassabis 联合创始人以及社交媒体网站 X 和 AI 助手 Grok 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的赞赏。 然而，一些行业人士表示，这种担忧被夸大了，并被用来炒作该行业。 周二在旧金山举行的销售人员会议上，黄仁勋在谈到人工智能的潜在危险时，将当前的进步称为“一场新的工业革命”，但坚持认为人工智能公司应该从本质上进行自我监管。 他补充说，如果人工智能公司的领导者在任何时候对他们的产品缺乏信心，他们应该选择不发布该产品。 “这是一件非常明显的事情，”黄说。 “尽可能快地跑，但如果任何时候你觉得机构失控了，就停下来。” 让人工智能高管完全自我监管的想法在一些业内人士看来是个坏主意。 Anthropic 高管兼联合创始人杰克·克拉克 (Jack Clark) 周一对 BBC 表示，让人工智能成为一个“完全不受监管的行业”就像“掷骰子，风险巨大”。 由人工智能行业圣人 Yann LeCun 领导的 Logical Intelligence 首席商务官帕特里克·希尔曼 (Patrick Hillman) 周二指出，人们对科技公司做任何真正符合公共利益、外部利益的事情缺乏信心。 “当今美国人唯一可能比华盛顿更不信任的机构是硅谷。我在这两个地方工作和生活过，我向你们保证，你们都受到了这种怀疑，”希尔曼说。 “如果你认为你正在建造的东西是危险的，请告诉我们你准备停止做什么，”他补充道。 OpenAI 的领导者和...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, championed by leaders like Jensen Huang, brings immense praise and influence. Yet, as the technology's potential impact grows, so does the scrutiny. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that a person is tested by the praise they receive. The challenge for innovators is to temper ambition with wisdom and responsibility, ensuring that the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，在黄仁勋等领导者的推动下，带来了巨大的赞誉和影响力。然而，随着这项技术潜在影响的扩大，审查也随之增加。箴言27:21提醒我们，人受到的试炼在于他所受的称赞。创新者面临的挑战是将雄心与智慧和责任相结合，确保追求进步不会超越伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: AI app ads promoting 'objectification of women' banned by watchdog
title.zh: 人工智能应用广告宣扬“物化女性”被监管机构禁止

summary.en: The UK's Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) has banned several social media adverts for AI apps, citing their promotion of "the creation of sexually explicit content and objectification of women." The regulator highlighted concerns about harmful gender stereotypes and the sexualization of minors in some ads, noting...
summary.zh: 英国广告标准局（ASA）已禁止了多则人工智能（AI）应用程序的社交媒体广告，理由是它们宣扬“创建色情内容和物化女性”。监管机构特别指出，其中一些广告包含有害的性别刻板印象和对未成年人的性化描述，并表示Meta已自行移除了相关内容。

body.en:
A series of social media adverts for AI apps have been banned by a UK watchdog for promoting "the creation of sexually explicit content and objectification of women".

The Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) said five ads uploaded to Meta platforms for AI companion and video generating apps had objectified and sexualised women, including through harmful gender stereotypes.

One of the ads used sexualised images of a girl under 18 to promote an AI companion app - while others invited users to upload images of their "crush" and turn images into "sizzling" videos.

Meta had already removed the offending ads. But Nicky Baker of the ASA said such content had the potential "to cause real-world harm".

"We take a firm line on ads that are likely to cause serious or widespread offence and these ads are a clear example of why that matters," she said.

"Encouraging and condoning the objectification of women and the creation of explicit content from people's images has the potential to cause real-world harm."

The ASA also said many of the ads it banned had promoted the creation of sexually explicit content using real women's images without their consent.

It comes only months after the UK outlawed apps to create non-consensual deepfake nude imagery - sparked by outrage over X's chatbot Grok complying with requests to nudify images of women on the platform .

The ASA said the law had changed during its investigations and that ads identified in future would be considered in light of both the law and its own rules.

Where ads are identified as illegal, it said it may notify platforms and law enforcement.

The ads were identified by the regulator using its AI-powered "Active Ad Monitoring System", which proactively searches for ads which might violate UK rules.

It said the five ads it were banned had depicted women irresponsibly, and were likely to cause serious or widespread offence.

One ad for an AI companion generator, developed by Animcha Ltd, was also found to have portrayed someone under 18 in a sexual way, the ASA said.

It presented the synthetic female character as someone users could "customise" and instruct, combining sexualised imagery with childlike clothing and objects.

Two ads for an AI portrait generation tool called Nexaipic encouraged users to "upload your crush and let AI create what you imagine" with sexually explicit videos.

An ad for an AI image-to-video generation app, identified only as KH31 DD22, depicted a clothed woman being transformed into a video in which she was topless.

The watchdog said this suggested the app could be used to create content that exposed women's bodies.

Further adverts for image generation tool Rusto AI, which encouraged users to create sexualised videos from photographs, were found to have condoned the...
body.zh: 英国监管机构禁止了一系列人工智能应用程序的社交媒体广告，理由是“创建露骨的色情内容和物化女性”。 广告标准局 (ASA) 表示，上传到 Meta 平台的人工智能伴侣和视频生成应用程序的 5 个广告将女性物化和性感化，包括通过有害的性别刻板印象。 其中一则广告使用了 18 岁以下女孩的性感图像来宣传一款人工智能伴侣应用程序，而其他广告则邀请用户上传他们“暗恋”的图像，并将图像变成“炙手可热”的视频。 Meta 已经删除了违规广告。但 ASA 的 Nicky Baker 表示，此类内容有可能“对现实世界造成伤害”。 她说：“我们对可能造成严重或广泛冒犯的广告采取坚定立场，这些广告清楚地说明了这一点的重要性。” “鼓励和纵容女性的物化以及从人物图像中创造露骨的内容有可能对现实世界造成伤害。” ASA 还表示，其禁止的许多广告未经女性同意，就使用真实女性图像宣传露骨的色情内容。 就在几个月前，英国宣布禁止创建未经同意的深度伪造裸体图像的应用程序，此举的起因是人们对 X 的聊天机器人 Grok 遵守平台上裸露女性图像的要求而引发的愤怒。 ASA 表示，法律在调查过程中发生了变化，未来确定的广告将根据法律和自己的规则进行考虑。 如果广告被认定为非法，它表示可能会通知平台和执法部门。 监管机构使用人工智能驱动的“主动广告监控系统”来识别这些广告，该系统会主动搜索可能违反英国规则的广告。 该公司表示，被禁的五个广告不负责任地描绘了女性，可能会造成严重或广泛的冒犯。 ASA 表示，Animcha Ltd 开发的一则人工智能伴侣生成器广告也被发现以性方式描绘了 18 岁以下的人。 它呈现了用户可以“定制”和指导的合成女性角色，将性感的图像与童趣的服装和物品结合起来。 名为 Nexaipic 的人工智能肖像生成工具的两则广告鼓励用户通过露骨的色情视频“上传你的迷恋，让人工智能创造你的想象”。 一则人工智能图像到视频生成应用程序的广告（仅标识为 KH31 DD22）描绘了一名穿着衣服的女性被转变成一段赤裸上身的视频。 该监管机构表示，这表明该应用程序可用于创建暴露女性身体的内容。 图像生成工具 Rusto AI 的进一步广告鼓励用户根据照片创建色情视频，但被发现纵容了……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI tools presents both opportunities and profound ethical challenges. When these technologies are used to create content that objectifies or sexualizes individuals, especially minors, it directly assaults human dignity. The biblical principle that every person is created in the image of God (Genesis 1:27) calls us to recognize and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能工具的飞速发展带来了机遇，也带来了深刻的伦理挑战。当这些技术被用来制造物化或性化个体（尤其是未成年人）的内容时，这直接侵犯了人的尊严。《创世记》1章27节指出，每个人都是按雅伟的形象所造，这呼召我们要认识并维护所有人的内在价值，要求我们的技术创造物反映这种神圣的价值，而不是贬低它。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

This week, we explore how parents and children can navigate school and future careers with the increasing importance of AI. body.en: AI is developing rapidly. What should parents and children make of it all? And how can young people navigate school and future careers when AI is becoming increasingly important? We speak to an expert who has written a new book about these issues. Also this week: we find out how one piece of health tech is helping scientists uncover disease-fighting data in menstrual blood. body.zh: 人工智能正在快速发展。父母和孩子应该如何看待这一切？当人工智能变得越来越重要时，年轻人如何驾驭学校和未来的职业？我们采访了一位专家，他写了一本关于这些问题的新书。同样在本周：我们了解一项健康技术如何帮助科学家发现经血中的抗病数据。印度尼西亚的自然资源保护主义者利用卫星成像来保护稀有猩猩物种的栖息地。主持人：Shiona McCallum 制片人：Tom Quinn（照片：一名女学生坐在计算机实验室的笔记本电脑前。她戴着耳机。图片来源：Getty Images）

As knowledge and understanding expand exponentially, as described in Daniel 12:4, it is crucial to equip young minds not only with technical skills but also with wisdom and discernment. May we guide children to use these powerful new tools...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展给下一代带来了机遇和挑战。正如但以理书12:4所描述的，随着知识和理解力的指数级增长，至关重要的是不仅要为年轻的心灵配备技术技能，还要赋予他们智慧和辨别力。愿我们引导孩子们将这些强大的新工具用于善事，反映造物主的形象。

title.en: Do whales grieve? Scientists’ research off Australia’s Gold Coast suggests they might | Olaf Meynecke for the Conversation
title.zh: 鲸鱼会悲伤吗？澳大利亚黄金海岸的科学研究表明它们可能会

summary.en: Researchers observed a humpback whale mother repeatedly returning to her deceased newborn calf on the seafloor for over an hour, gently touching it. This behavior is the first described instance of a humpback mother caring for her dead calf and raises questions about how highly social animals respond to death.
summary.zh: 研究人员观察到一只座头鲸母亲在一个多小时的时间里反复回到海床上死去的刚出生的幼崽身边，温柔地抚摸它。这种行为是首次被描述的座头鲸母亲照顾死去的幼崽的案例，并引发了关于高度社会化动物如何应对死亡的问题。

body.en:
One day last July, a newborn humpback whale calf lay motionless on the seafloor, just a kilometre off Australia’s Gold Coast. The encounter was captured through underwater video .

For more than an hour, the mother repeatedly returned to the same spot, gently touching the calf with her head and pectoral fin and resting beside it eye-to-eye. Our new research suggests this is the first described case of a humpback whale mother caring for her deceased newborn calf.

The encounter offers a rare window into one of the least understood aspects of whale behaviour: how these highly social animals respond to death.

And it raises the question: do whales, and other highly social animals such as elephants, grieve?

Humpback whales are known for their spectacular migrations and acrobatic breaches. However, they are equally remarkable for the way they respond to other animals in distress.

Humpback whales often defend their calves from killer whales. Researchers have also observed them remaining alongside whales that are injured or entangled in nets , circling them, resting nearby and attempting to assist. Humpback whales may even intervene when killer whales attack seals, sea lions and grey whale calves.

These responses of care and attention are known as epimeletic behaviour and are common among cetaceans , a group of marine mammals including whales, dolphins and porpoises. Dolphins and killer whales often remain close to distressed companions, evidence of their strong social bonds. These animals may even risk their own lives for others. This happened in April off Scotland’s north-west coast, when multiple pilot whales became stranded after following a birthing female.

Killer whale mothers have repeatedly been observed carrying their dead calves for hours, days and, in exceptional cases, weeks. The most famous example is the killer whale Tahlequah , who in 2018 carried her dead calf for 17 days over more than 1,500 kilometres. Scientists have observed similar behaviour in pilot whales and dolphins.

Such prolonged responses illustrate the strength of the bond between mother and calf. Maternal instincts and hormonal changes after birth may contribute to mothers remaining with their deceased offspring. But exactly what the animals understand about death remains unknown.

Until now, scientists have almost exclusively documented these epimeletic behaviours towards deceased calves in toothed whales . The research on baleen whales, including humpback whales, is scarce. This is likely because dead newborn baleen whales often sink quickly, making it extremely difficult to observe such cases.

Humpback whale mothers give birth after almost a year of pregnancy and spend the next few months feeding their calf with nutrient-rich milk. Right after the delivery, mothers...
body.zh: 去年七月的一天，一头新生座头鲸幼崽一动不动地躺在距离澳大利亚黄金海岸仅一公里的海底。这次遭遇是通过水下视频记录下来的。 在一个多小时的时间里，母亲反复回到同一个地方，用头和胸鳍轻轻地触碰小牛，并在旁边四目相对地休息。我们的新研究表明，这是首次描述座头鲸母亲照顾死去的新生幼崽的案例。 这次遭遇为了解鲸鱼行为中最不为人所知的方面之一提供了一个难得的窗口：这些高度社会化的动物如何应对死亡。 这就提出了一个问题：鲸鱼和其他高度社会化的动物（例如大象）会悲伤吗？ 座头鲸以其壮观的迁徙和杂技般的跃出而闻名。然而，它们对其他遇险动物的反应方式也同样引人注目。 座头鲸经常保护它们的幼崽免受虎鲸的侵害。研究人员还观察到它们留在受伤或被网缠住的鲸鱼旁边，围着它们转，在附近休息并试图提供帮助。当虎鲸攻击海豹、海狮和灰鲸幼崽时，座头鲸甚至可能会进行干预。 这些关心和关注的反应被称为表观行为，在鲸目动物中很常见，鲸目动物是一组海洋哺乳动物，包括鲸鱼、海豚和鼠海豚。海豚和虎鲸经常与受苦的同伴保持密切关系，这证明了它们牢固的社会联系。这些动物甚至可能为了他人而冒着生命危险。这件事发生在四月份苏格兰西北海岸附近，当时多头领航鲸在追随一头正在分娩的雌性鲸鱼后搁浅。 人们多次观察到虎鲸妈妈带着死去的幼鲸数小时、数天，在特殊情况下甚至数周。最著名的例子是虎鲸塔勒夸 (Tahlequah)，它在 2018 年携带死去的幼鲸长达 17 天，行程超过 1,500 公里。科学家们在领航鲸和海豚身上观察到了类似的行为。 如此长时间的反应说明了母亲和小牛之间的联系的强度。母性本能和出生后荷尔蒙的变化可能有助于母亲与已故的后代在一起。但动物们对死亡的具体理解仍然未知。 到目前为止，科学家几乎完全记录了齿鲸对死去幼崽的这些表观行为。对须鲸（包括座头鲸）的研究很少。这可能是因为死去的新生须鲸经常很快下沉，因此很难观察到这种情况。 座头鲸母亲在怀孕近一年后生下孩子，并在接下来的几个月里用营养丰富的牛奶喂养幼崽。产后，妈妈们...

reflection.en: The profound connection between a mother and her calf is evident in this heartbreaking scene off Australia's Gold Coast. The mother whale's persistent, gentle attention to her deceased newborn speaks to a deep bond that transcends simple instinct. Jesus himself wept at the tomb of Lazarus, showing that even divine love acknowledges and shares in our deepest...
reflection.zh: 在澳大利亚黄金海岸发生的这一令人心碎的场景中，母子之间深厚的联系显而易见。鲸鱼母亲对死去的幼崽持续而温柔的关注，体现了一种超越简单本能的深厚纽带。耶稣本人在拉撒路的坟墓前也曾哭泣，表明即使是神圣的爱也承认并分担我们最深切的悲伤。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.zh: 气候危机可能是导致尼泊尔-西藏洪水灾难的罪魁祸首，首次研究发现，此次洪水已造成1300多人死亡

summary.en: Scientists suggest that global heating destabilized a 200,000 sq meter glacier, leading to its collapse in August. This event triggered massive flash floods in Nepal and Tibet, causing over 1,300 deaths, according to the first scientific study of the disaster. summary.zh: 科学家们认为，全球变暖破坏了8月份倒塌的20万平方米的冰川。据首次对该灾难进行的科学研究显示，这一事件引发了尼泊尔和西藏大规模的洪水，造成1300多人死亡。研究指出，冰川倒塌前出现了异常的温暖天气，释放了1.1亿立方米的冰雪。
