Researchers identified unusually warm conditions before the glacier’s collapse , which sent an avalanche of 110m cubic metres (3,885 cu ft) of snow and ice into the valley below. This triggered flash floods on an almost unprecedented scale, hitting communities downstream without warning. Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家表示，全球变暖是导致 8 月份 20 万平方米冰川崩塌的不稳定因素。第一项针对这场灾难的科学研究发现，气候崩溃可能削弱了上个月崩塌的冰川，导致尼泊尔和西藏发生灾难性洪水，造成数百人死亡。研究人员在冰川崩塌之前发现了异常温暖的气候，导致 110m 立方米（3,885 立方英尺）的雪和冰雪崩进入下面的山谷。这引发了几乎前所未有的规模的山洪，毫无预警地袭击了下游社区。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact. This devastating flood, linked to climate breakdown, serves as a stark reminder of our interconnectedness with creation. As we witness such events, we are called to lament the damage and seek ways to live in greater harmony with the natural world Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动带来的重负。这场与气候崩溃有关的毁灭性洪水，是提醒我们与雅伟所造之物息息相关的一个严峻教训。当我们目睹这样的事件时，我们被呼召为所造成的破坏而哀恸，并寻求以更和谐的方式与雅伟托付给我们的自然世界共处。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘Don’t shoot. Listen’: The AI-aided quest to understand Yellowstone’s wolves
title.zh: “别开枪。听着”：人工智能助力探寻黄石狼的奥秘

summary.en: Jeff Reed, initially influenced by the 'Little Red Riding Hood' myth that portrayed wolves as villains, had a life-changing encounter on his Montana farm five years ago. Instead of shooting a wolf he mistook for a large coyote in his headlights, he hesitated, opened his truck door, and found himself face-to-face with...
summary.zh: 杰夫·里德从小就受到“小红帽”故事的影响，认为狼是邪恶的。然而，五年前在蒙大拿州的农场上发生的一次改变他一生的经历，让他对狼有了新的认识。他本想射杀一头他误认为是郊狼的狼，但在车灯的照射下，他看到了一只巨大的灰狼，并犹豫了。他打开车门，端起步枪，但最终没有开枪。

body.en: Jeff Reed wasn’t raised to hate wolves. But as a child he bought into the Little Red Riding Hood myth regarding their villainous nature. You see one, you shoot it. But not on a night on his Montana farm some five years ago, a night that proved life-changing not only for Reed, but perhaps for the study and conservation of wolves. “I thought it was a large coyote,” Reed recalls. “It was standing broadside in my [pickup truck] headlights, like 10 yards away, this big, beautiful gray wolf. And he’s just looking at me. I open the door, grab my rifle, and he’s standing there … I’m pointing my barrel, looking at it. “Then all of a sudden — you can call it an Apostle Paul sees Jesus for the first time and goes blind moment — and I just go, ‘What the hell am I doing? Why am I doing this?’ So I shot over its back, like way high. It didn’t bolt. It just trotted right beside me … and kept going.” Reed heeded that night’s sacred call. It wasn’t long before wolf indifference morphed into obsession, and led to his linking up with the world’s leading long-term wolf research effort. Which may seem like an odd fit, Reed being a Ph.D. linguist who spent much of his career up to that point leading software engineering for Silicon Valley firms. But all that knowledge has intertwined perfectly: The Cry Wolf Project is grounded in bioacoustics and artificial intelligence…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 杰夫·里德从小就讨厌狼。但小时候，他相信小红帽的邪恶本性。你看到一个，就射击它。但五年前他在蒙大拿州农场的一个夜晚却并非如此，事实证明，这个夜晚不仅改变了里德的生活，也可能改变了狼的研究和保护。 “我以为那是一只大郊狼，”里德回忆道。 “它站在我的[皮卡车]车头灯的侧面，大约10码外，这只又大又漂亮的灰狼。他只是看着我。我打开门，抓起我的步枪，他就站在那里......我指着我的枪管，看着它。“然后突然间——你可以称之为使徒保罗第一次看到耶稣，然后瞬间——我就盲目了，‘我到底在做什么？我为什么要这样做？’于是我从它的背上射击，射得很高。它没有螺栓。它就在我身边小跑……然后继续前行。”里德响应了那天晚上神圣的召唤。没过多久，对狼的冷漠就变成了痴迷，并促使他与世界领先的长期狼研究工作建立了联系。这似乎有点奇怪，因为里德是一名博士。语言学家，在此之前他的大部分职业生涯都在领导硅谷公司的软件工程。但所有这些知识都完美地交织在一起：“狼来了”项目以生物声学和人工智能为基础……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The instinct to react with immediate force, born from fear or ingrained prejudice, is a powerful human tendency. Jeff Reed's story shows a moment of pause, a refusal to let fear dictate action. In choosing not to shoot, he opened himself to a different kind of encounter, one that bypasses the cycle of violence and allows for understanding.
reflection.zh: 出于恐惧或根深蒂固的偏见而立即采取行动的本能，是一种强大的人类倾向。杰夫·里德的故事展现了一个停顿的时刻，一种拒绝让恐惧主导行动的选择。通过选择不射击，他为一种不同的相遇敞开了大门，这种相遇绕过了暴力的循环，带来了理解的可能性。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Bolivia’s mining law overhaul raises environmental and community concerns
title.zh: 玻利维亚的矿业法改革引发环境和社区担忧

summary.en: Bolivia is undertaking a significant overhaul of its primary mining laws to modernize the industry and enhance oversight. However, civil society and Indigenous groups have voiced concerns regarding the process. Officials maintain that the new mining code will foster economic development while incorporating...
summary.zh: 玻利维亚正在对其主要矿业法进行重大改革，以实现行业现代化并加强监管。然而，民间社会和原住民团体对这一过程表示担忧。官员们坚称，新的矿业法将促进经济发展并包含环境保护措施，强调需要法律确定性和明确的规则来支持该行业的发展。

body.en: Bolivia recently began overhauling one of its principal mining laws, with the goal of modernizing the industry and improving oversight. Civil society and Indigenous groups have raised concerns about the process, but officials say the new mining code will promote economic development and include environmental protections. “We want a mining code that responds to the current needs of the sector, generates legal certainty, and establishes clear rules to support the development of Bolivian mining,” Marco Antonio Calderón de la Barca Quintanilla, the minister of mining and metallurgy, said in a statement. The ministry says it’s held weekly meetings with key mining stakeholders about their concerns and proposals for the new mining code. This month, their ideas were given to a technical committee to consider while drafting a preliminary bill, which will be delivered to the national legislature for approval. The government hasn’t announced when the bill will be completed. The current code was passed in 2014 and establishes the mechanisms for mining development, environmental oversight, and the participation of local and Indigenous communities, among other things. Updates will focus on strengthening mining rights, promoting investment, formalizing mining activity, and improving transparency, a ministry statement said. Updates will also involve “consolidating responsible environmental management.” The details of potential changes haven’t been finalized or released. But local reports said some ideas have included new tax and royalty structures, removing the 30-year limit on mining contracts to extend them indefinitely, and restructuring the ministry and other mining institutions. Other ideas include protections for…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 玻利维亚最近开始彻底修改其一项主要采矿法，目标是实现行业现代化并改善监管。民间社会和原住民团体对这一过程表示担忧，但官员们表示，新的采矿法规将促进经济发展并包括环境保护。矿业和冶金部长马科·安东尼奥·卡尔德龙·德拉·巴尔卡·金塔尼利亚在一份声明中表示：“我们希望制定一个采矿法规，能够满足该行业当前的需求，产生法律确定性，并制定明确的规则来支持玻利维亚采矿业的发展。”该部表示，它每周与主要矿业利益相关者举行会议，讨论他们对新采矿法规的担忧和建议。本月，他们的想法已提交给技术委员会在起草初步法案时考虑，该法案将提交国家立法机关批准。政府尚未宣布该法案何时完成。现行法规于 2014 年通过，建立了采矿开发、环境监督以及当地和原住民社区参与等机制。一份声明称，更新内容将侧重于加强采矿权、促进投资、规范采矿活动以及提高透明度。更新还将涉及“巩固负责任的环境管理”。潜在变化的细节尚未最终确定或发布。但当地报道称，一些想法包括新的税收和特许权使用费结构、取消采矿合同 30 年的限制并无限期延长合同，以及重组该部和其他采矿机构。其他想法包括保护……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: As Bolivia revises its mining laws, the tension between economic development and environmental stewardship is palpable. This situation calls to mind the ancient truth that the Earth and all its fullness belong to the Creator. Responsible management of resources, respecting both the land and the communities it sustains, reflects a deeper understanding of our...
reflection.zh: 随着玻利维亚修订其矿业法，经济发展与环境保护之间的紧张关系显而易见。这种情况让人想起一个古老的真理：地和其中所充满的都属于造物主。负责任地管理资源，尊重土地及其所供养的社区，体现了对我们在雅伟最终所有权下作为管家角色的更深层理解。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: EU plans new firefighting fleet after deadly summer heat wave
title.zh: 欧盟在致命热浪后计划组建新的消防机队

summary.en: Following a summer of extreme heat that caused widespread death and dried up rivers across the European Union, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced plans for a new European Heatwave Plan and a future European firefighting fleet. The EU currently coordinates a network of aircraft and resources,...
summary.zh: 在经历了导致欧盟各地河流干涸、数十万人死亡的极端酷暑之后，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩宣布了新的欧洲热浪计划和未来的欧洲消防机队计划。欧盟目前协调着飞机和资源的网络，但近期灾难的规模要求开发新的工具来应对日益恶化的气候。

body.en: BRUSSELS (AP) — A scorching summer that dried up rivers and killed tens of thousands across the European Union from Portugal to Hungary has shown that the bloc needs to develop new tools to meet a worsening climate, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said Wednesday. She said that this instability led her to propose a new European Heatwave Plan as well as a future European firefighting fleet of airplanes. Currently, the EU operates a small fleet itself but coordinates a network of aircraft, water trucks and volunteers that move across the 27-nation bloc as fires ignite. “This summer was the summer of truth. Almost no part of our continent was spared,” said the EU executive during her annual State of the European Union address in Strasbourg. “Key rivers like the Danube, the Rhine or La Garonne are disappearing before our eyes. More than 35,000 additional deaths during the heat waves. Care homes and hospitals dangerously overheated.” The extreme heat, which hit Europe exceptionally hard and early this year appears to have led to a much higher spike in deaths than expected. Where Von der Leyen’s figure of 35,000 comes from is unclear, but it is triple the estimates of “excessive deaths” by monitoring groups in July. Fires in France and Spain drove hundreds of thousands of people to flee their homes, shut down nuclear reactors in Hungary and France, ignited century-old munitions on Belgium’s border with Germany and revealed previously lost ships sunk on riverbeds like a tugboat in Serbia. The heat and humidity that broke…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 布鲁塞尔（美联社）——欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩周三表示，炎热的夏季导致河流干涸，从葡萄牙到匈牙利，整个欧盟范围内数万人死亡，这表明欧盟需要开发新工具来应对日益恶化的气候。她说，这种不稳定促使她提出了一项新的欧洲热浪计划以及未来的欧洲消防机队。目前，欧盟本身运营着一支小型机队，但协调一个由飞机、水车和志愿者组成的网络，在火灾发生时在 27 个欧盟国家之间移动。 “今年夏天是真相之夏。我们大陆的几乎所有地区都未能幸免，”这位欧盟高管在斯特拉斯堡举行的年度欧盟国情咨文中表示。 “多瑙河、莱茵河或加龙河等主要河流正在我们眼前消失。热浪期间新增死亡人数超过 35,000 人。疗养院和医院的过热状况非常危险。”今年年初对欧洲造成格外严重的极端高温似乎导致死亡人数大幅高于预期。冯德莱恩所说的 35,000 人的数字从何而来尚不清楚，但它是监测组织 7 月份估计的“过度死亡”的三倍。法国和西班牙的大火迫使数十万人逃离家园，关闭了匈牙利和法国的核反应堆，点燃了比利时与德国边境上已有百年历史的弹药，并让之前失踪的船只像塞尔维亚的拖船一样沉没在河床上。打破的炎热和潮湿......本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: This summer's devastating heatwave across Europe, which claimed tens of thousands of lives, serves as a stark reminder of our planet's fragility. The EU's proposed firefighting fleet and heatwave plan are practical responses to a crisis that demands human ingenuity and collective action. As we witness the Earth's distress, we are called to remember that all...
reflection.zh: 今年夏天席卷欧洲的毁灭性热浪夺去了数万人的生命，这 stark 地提醒我们地球的脆弱性。欧盟提出的消防机队和热浪计划是对一场危机的实际应对，这场危机需要人类的智慧和集体行动。当我们目睹地球的苦难时，我们被呼召要记住万物都属于雅伟，这促使我们承担起负责任的管理和对受造物的关怀。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: At Least 124 Environmental Defenders Killed Worldwide Last Year
title.zh: 去年全球至少有124名环境卫士遇害

summary.en: A new report reveals that at least 124 individuals were murdered last year for defending their natural environments, such as forests, farms, and waterways. The report's authors attribute this violence, partly, to reduced foreign aid weakening human rights groups that support these defenders, with specific mention of...
summary.zh: 一份新报告显示，去年至少有124名个人因捍卫森林、农场或水道等自然环境而遭到谋杀。报告作者认为，这种暴力部分归因于富裕国家削减对外援助，削弱了支持这些卫士的人权团体，并特别提到了援助削减对哥伦比亚相关工作的影响。

body.en:
At least 124 people were murdered last year for defending their forests, farms, or waterways from destruction or degradation, according to a stark new report. Its authors say that deep cuts to foreign aid by wealthy nations have weakened human rights groups that support environmental defenders.

“The effects of these budget cuts are not abstract,” said Juliana Vélez Echeverri , a senior campaigner with the watchdog group Global Witness, which published the report . “In Colombia, projects working to promote and protect human rights and support defenders have been hit by the sudden drop in foreign aid, particularly from the U.S.”

Land disputes were linked to more than half of the killings of environmental defenders last year, while roughly a third of those killed were Indigenous people, according to the report. Latin America accounted for 85 percent of killings, making it the deadliest region for defenders, a distinction it has earned every year since Global Witness began tracking killings in 2012.

Last year Colombia led the world with 39 murders, followed by Brazil with 26. Colombia has seen a surge in the growing of coca, used to make cocaine, and its cultivation is driving conflicts over land, putting defenders in the crosshairs of drug traffickers. In Brazil, killings were concentrated at the edges of the Amazon, where miners, loggers, and ranchers are illegally pushing further into the rainforest.

The Philippines was once again the deadliest country in Asia. It recorded 12 killings last year, as armed forces cracked down on activists. Killings were lower elsewhere on the continent, though the report documents how Indonesia has moved to criminalize activism, while regimes in Russia and across Central Asian nations have worked to discredit political opponents through online smear campaigns.
body.zh: 一份严峻的新报告显示，去年至少有 124 人因保护森林、农场或水道免遭破坏或退化而被谋杀。该报告的作者表示，富裕国家大幅削减对外援助削弱了支持环境捍卫者的人权组织。 “这些预算削减的影响并不抽象，”发布该报告的监督组织全球见证的高级活动家朱莉安娜·贝莱斯·埃切维里 (Juliana Vélez Echeverri) 表示。 “在哥伦比亚，致力于促进和保护人权以及支持维权者的项目受到了外国援助突然减少的打击，特别是来自美国的援助。” 报告称，去年一半以上的环境捍卫者遇害事件与土地纠纷有关，而其中约三分之一的遇害者是原住民。拉丁美洲占杀戮事件的 85%，使其成为维权者死亡最严重的地区，自全球见证 2012 年开始追踪杀戮事件以来，该地区每年都获得这一殊荣。 去年，哥伦比亚发生了 39 起谋杀案，位居世界第一，其次是巴西，有 26 起。哥伦比亚用于制造可卡因的古柯种植量激增，其种植加剧了土地冲突，使捍卫者成为毒贩的目标。在巴西，杀戮集中在亚马逊地区的边缘，那里的矿工、伐木者和牧场主正在非法深入雨林。 菲律宾再次成为亚洲死亡人数最多的国家。去年，武装部队镇压活动人士，导致 12 人被杀。非洲大陆其他地方的杀戮人数较低，但报告记录了印度尼西亚如何将激进主义定为犯罪，而俄罗斯和整个中亚国家的政权则致力于通过网上抹黑运动来抹黑政治对手。

reflection.en: The earth groans under the weight of destruction, and its defenders pay the ultimate price for speaking for its protection. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves,' a mandate that extends to the natural world itself, which has no voice to plead its case against exploitation. May we find courage to advocate for...
reflection.zh: 大地在毁灭的重压下呻吟，而它的捍卫者们为保护它付出了生命的代价。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话者说话”，这一使命也延伸至自然界本身，它无法为自己免遭剥削而辩护。愿我们找到勇气去倡导保护造物，即使代价高昂。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Trump EPA’s arguments for letting power plants spew unlimited pollution ‘dead wrong’
title.zh: 特朗普环保署关于允许发电厂排放无限污染的论点“大错特错”

summary.en: Claims that dismantling pollution rules will lower energy bills and have little climate impact are far from convincing. In allowing US power plants to emit any amount of planet-heating pollution they wish to, the Trump administration made two striking claims – that this will cut Americans’ electricity bills and that...
summary.zh: 关于放松污染法规将降低电费且对气候影响甚微的说法远不能令人信服。允许美国发电厂排放任意数量的导致地球变暖的污染物，特朗普政府提出了两个惊人的论点——这将削减美国人的电费，并且污染物本身无关紧要。这两个论点都难以经受最基本的审视。周一，美国环保署（EPA）表示将取消对煤炭和天然气发电厂排放的限制，这些排放物正在危险地加热...

body.en: Claims that dismantling pollution rules will lower energy bills and have little climate impact are far from convincing In allowing US power plants to emit any amount of planet-heating pollution they wish to, the Trump administration made two striking claims – that this will cut Americans’ electricity bills and that the pollution itself doesn’t really matter anyway. Both claims struggle to stand up to even basic scrutiny. On Monday, the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) said it would erase any limits on emissions from coal and gas plants that are dangerously heating up our planet. This move, which follows a similar dismantling of pollution limits from cars ands trucks, is part of a broader push to eliminate the longstanding legal authority of this, or any future, US administration to deal with the climate crisis. Continue reading...
body.zh: 声称废除污染规则将降低能源费用并对气候影响很小的说法远不能令人信服。在允许美国发电厂排放任何数量的地球供暖污染物时，特朗普政府提出了两个引人注目的主张——这将减少美国人的电费，而且污染本身并不重要。这两种说法都难以经受哪怕是基本的审查。周一，美国环境保护署（EPA）表示，将取消对煤炭和天然气发电厂排放的任何限制，这些发电厂正在危险地使我们的星球升温。此举是在取消汽车和卡车污染限制之后采取的一项更广泛行动的一部分，旨在消除本届或未来任何美国政府应对气候危机的长期法律权威。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news reports that the Trump administration's arguments for dismantling pollution rules are being challenged as "dead wrong." This raises questions about accountability and the integrity of claims made by those in power. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, urging a commitment to...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道称，特朗普政府放松污染法规的论点被质疑为“大错特错”。这引发了关于问责制以及当权者所做声明的诚信问题。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的领导力包括秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，敦促人们致力于真理和道德治理。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Record heatwaves bring Britain’s second-best butterfly season in 16 years
title.zh: 创纪录高温带来英国16年来第二佳蝴蝶季

summary.en: Volunteers counted almost 1.4m common butterflies and moths, with painted ladies up 335% on last year. The record-breaking heat of 2026 delivered the second-best British butterfly season of the past 16 years, according to the Big Butterfly Count. The largest insect count in the world, in which more than 100,000...
summary.zh: 志愿者们统计了近140万只常见的蝴蝶和飞蛾，其中纹白蝶的数量比去年增加了335%。根据“大蝴蝶统计”的数据，2026年创纪录的高温带来了英国过去16年来第二好的蝴蝶季。这项世界上最大的昆虫统计活动，有超过10万名志愿者统计了近140万只常见的蝴蝶和白天飞行的蛾子，证实了许多人的体验——在长达五个星期的热浪夏季里，蝴蝶数...

body.en: Volunteers counted almost 1.4m common butterflies and moths, with painted ladies up 335% on last year The recording-breaking heat of 2026 delivered the second-best British butterfly season of the past 16 years, according to the Big Butterfly Count . The largest insect count in the world, in which more than 100,000 volunteers counted almost 1.4m common butterflies and day-flying moths, confirmed what many people experienced – a noticeable profusion of butterflies during the five-heatwave summer. Continue reading...
body.zh: 志愿者清点了近 140 万只普通蝴蝶和飞蛾，其中彩绘蝴蝶数量比去年增加了 335%。根据 Big Butterfly Count 的数据，2026 年破纪录的高温带来了过去 16 年来第二好的英国蝴蝶季节。世界上最大规模的昆虫统计，超过 100,000 名志愿者统计了近 140 万只普通蝴蝶和飞蛾，证实了许多人的经历——在五次热浪夏季期间，蝴蝶数量明显增多。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Even amidst record heatwaves, the natural world displays remarkable resilience and beauty, as seen in Britain's flourishing butterfly population. This abundance serves as a testament to the intricate design and power of the Creator, whose invisible attributes are clearly perceived through the wonders of creation. It invites us to pause and recognize the...
reflection.zh: 即使在创纪录的热浪中，自然界也展现出惊人的韧性和美丽，英国蝴蝶数量的繁盛便是明证。这种丰饶证明了造物主精妙的设计和力量，祂那不可见的神性特质，借着受造物的奇妙，可以被清晰地看见。这邀请我们停下脚步，认识到那编织在生命之中的神圣艺术。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Country diary: Drama on the trail cam – this is Somerset’s version of the snow leopard | Derek Niemann
title.zh: 乡村日记： the trail cam 上的戏剧——这是萨默塞特郡的雪豹版本

summary.en: In Frome, Somerset, efforts to help struggling hedgehogs have finally yielded a sighting. The story questions the extent of human intervention, detailing a hedgehog's escape from a predator via a tunnel, where its own defenses deterred the hunter. This encounter raises questions about natural instincts and...
summary.zh: 在萨默塞特郡的弗洛姆，帮助挣扎的刺猬的努力终于得到了一个目击。故事质疑人类干预的程度，详细描述了一只刺猬通过隧道逃脱捕食者，其自身的防御措施吓退了猎人。这次遭遇引发了关于自然本能和干预的问题。

body.en: Frome: We’ve been trying to help out struggling hedgehogs, and finally we have a sighting. But how long should we intervene for? Deep into the night, and out of our sight, tiny claws rake over plastic. The animal skitters halfway through a pipe, then stops. A hunter five times its weight is on its tail, but it is safe from harm, and not just because the tunnel is too narrow for the hunter to enter. Curiosity killed the cat’s predatory thoughts with a face full of prickles a long time ago. The cat sniffs the tube, and wanders off. Continue reading...
body.zh: 弗罗姆：我们一直在努力帮助陷入困境的刺猬，最后我们看到了它们。但我们应该干预多久呢？夜色深处，在我们的视线之外，小爪子在塑料上耙着。这只动物在管道中滑行了一半，然后停了下来。一个体重是其体重五倍的猎人在尾巴上，但它不会受到伤害，这不仅仅是因为隧道太窄，猎人无法进入。好奇心早已杀掉了满脸刺痛的猫的掠食念头。猫闻了闻管子，然后走开了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The natural world is a profound teacher. Observing the intricate dance of predator and prey, like the hedgehog escaping the cat thanks to its unique defenses and environment, reminds us that wisdom is often found in the details of creation. Yahweh's handiwork invites us to look closely and learn.
reflection.zh: 大自然是一位深刻的老师。观察捕食者与猎物之间错综复杂的互动，例如刺猬因其独特的防御和环境而逃脱猫的追捕，这提醒我们智慧常常蕴藏在创造的细节之中。雅伟的作为邀请我们仔细观察并从中学习。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: From Indigenous Loss, a Potent Legal Argument on Climate
title.zh: 从原住民的损失中，一个强有力的气候法律论点

summary.en: Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon discusses how global warming endangers not only the existence of small island nations but also the cultural traditions of their Indigenous inhabitants. He is incorporating these harms into legal challenges, which have already seen a significant victory at the International Court of...
summary.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿圭恩探讨了全球变暖如何不仅威胁到小岛屿国家的生存，也威胁到其原住民的传统。他正在将这些伤害纳入法律诉讼，包括在国际法院取得重大胜利。

body.en:
Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon explores how warming threatens not only the survival of small island nations but also the traditions of their Indigenous peoples. He is citing these injuries in legal actions, including in a major victory at the International Court of Justice last year.

Last year, the International Court of Justice unanimously ruled that countries have a legal obligation to limit greenhouse gas emissions. The decision was the culmination of a years-long campaign launched by a group of law students in the Pacific island nation of Vanuatu.

The landmark opinion , which said countries’ failure to address emissions from fossil fuels and other sources could carry legal consequences, provides a potentially powerful new tool for communities, organizations, or governments suing in national courts to compel climate action or win damages. It could also push international climate negotiators toward a more aggressive stance on a danger the judges called “urgent and existential.”

Julian Aguon, an Indigenous Chamorro human rights lawyer from Guam, wore a garland of coconut fronds and cowry shells as he argued Vanuatu’s case in The Hague. He and his colleagues had traveled across Melanesia and Micronesia to gather testimony from residents whose homes, cultures, and livelihoods are being devastated by climate change.

While the impact of climate change is typically measured in degrees of warming, feet of flooding, or monetary losses, for many Indigenous people it is inflicting a profound cultural, spiritual, and emotional injury that the sterile language of science and economics fails to capture, said Aguon, founder of the Guam-based Indigenous rights and environmental justice firm Blue Ocean Law. In an interview with Yale Environment 360, he said that highlighting the harms Indigenous peoples and cultures are suffering proved a potent legal strategy at the United Nations’ main judicial body.

“Climate change is unraveling the very terms by which people know themselves and keep covenant with the natural world.” In the ICJ case, he said, “we brought that to the court’s attention because these are rights violations of the highest order — violations of the right to life, the right to culture, the right to self-determination.”

Yale Environment 360 : Can you tell me about the testimonies you and your colleagues gathered when you traveled to Vanuatu, Fiji, and other island nations in preparation for the case? How did they shape your arguments in court?

Julian Aguon : There’s no way to translate the urgency and gravity of the climate crisis other than via firsthand accounts of loss and damage, so we wanted to foreground vulnerable communities’ experiences. The process revealed in spectacular ways just how emaciated the global discourse on climate harms...
body.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿古恩探讨了气候变暖如何不仅威胁小岛屿国家的生存，而且威胁其土著人民的传统。他在法律诉讼中引用了这些伤害，包括去年在国际法院取得的重大胜利。 去年，国际法院一致裁定各国有限制温室气体排放的法律义务。这一决定是太平洋岛国瓦努阿图的一群法律学生发起的长达数年运动的高潮。 这一具有里程碑意义的意见指出，各国未能解决化石燃料和其他来源的排放问题可能会带来法律后果，为社区、组织或政府在国家法院提起诉讼以强制采取气候行动或赢得损害赔偿提供了一个潜在的强大新工具。它还可能促使国际气候谈判代表对法官所说的“紧迫且事关生死存亡”的危险采取更积极的立场。 来自关岛的查莫罗原住民人权律师朱利安·阿古恩 (Julian Aguon) 在海牙为瓦努阿图的案件辩护时戴着椰子叶和贝壳制成的花环。他和他的同事们走遍了美拉尼西亚和密克罗尼西亚，收集那些家园、文化和生计正受到气候变化破坏的居民的证词。 总部位于关岛的原住民权利和环境正义公司“蓝海法”的创始人阿古恩表示，虽然气候变化的影响通常以变暖程度、洪水深度或金钱损失来衡量，但对许多原住民来说，它正在造成深刻的文化、精神和情感伤害，这是科学和经济学语言无法捕捉到的。在接受耶鲁环境 360 采访时，他表示，事实证明，强调土著人民和文化所遭受的伤害是联合国主要司法机构的有效法律策略。 “气候变化正在瓦解人们认识自己并与自然世界保持契约的条件。”他说，在国际法院案件中，“我们提请法院注意这一点，因为这些都是最高级别的侵犯权利行为——侵犯生命权、文化权和自决权。” 耶鲁环境 360：您能告诉我您和您的同事在前往瓦努阿图、斐济和其他岛国准备此案时收集的证词吗？他们如何影响你在法庭上的论点？ 朱利安·阿古恩：除了通过损失和损害的第一手资料之外，没有其他方法可以体现气候危机的紧迫性和严重性，因此我们希望突出弱势社区的经历。这一过程以惊人的方式揭示了全球关于气候危害的讨论是多么的无力……

reflection.en: In the face of climate change, the voices of Indigenous peoples and small island nations are often drowned out. Julian Aguon's legal advocacy, however, amplifies their suffering and demands accountability, embodying the principle of speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves. His work reminds us that justice requires us to champion the cause of the...
reflection.zh: 面对气候变化，原住民和小岛屿国家的呼声常常被淹没。然而，朱利安·阿圭恩的法律倡导放大了他们的痛苦，并要求问责，体现了为那些不能为自己发声的人说话的原则。他的工作提醒我们，正义要求我们为弱势群体争取权益，确保他们的困境被听到和解决。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Documentary Desk
title.zh: 纪录片精选

strap.en: New and notable documentaries — nature, creation, and the stories worth two hours of attention.
strap.zh: 值得关注的新纪录片——自然、受造世界，以及值得花两小时细看的故事。

title.en: Ex-BBC presenter questions role of Royal Family in new documentary
title.zh: 新纪录片中前BBC主持人质疑王室的作用

summary.en: Veteran broadcaster John Humphrys has released a new documentary, 'The Royals: Time to Go?', exploring the role of the Royal Family and arguing that the UK public should have the right to choose their leaders. The film features discussions with both critics and supporters of the monarchy.
summary.zh: 资深广播人约翰·汉弗莱斯推出了一部新纪录片《王室：是时候离开了？》，探讨了王室的作用，并主张英国公众应该有权选择自己的领导人。该片采访了君主制的批评者和支持者。

body.en:
Veteran broadcaster John Humphrys has said the people of the United Kingdom should "be able to choose our leaders" as he releases a documentary exploring the role of the Royal Family.

Humphrys, who for decades was one of the most prominent faces on the BBC, is presenting a new Channel 4 documentary called The Royals: Time to Go?

Speaking to BBC Radio Wales Breakfast , the Cardiff-born presenter said he "admires" King Charles III in many ways, but said it was a "matter of choice".

In the documentary, Humphrys speaks to both critics and supporters of the monarchy, and makes the case for electing a president as the head of state.

He recalled seeing the late Queen Elizabeth II visiting Cardiff when he was growing up, watching her being driven down Newport Road.

"My father didn't attend and said he would never bend the knee to anyone. I guess that rubbed off on me," he said.

Humphrys asked why it was seen as such a taboo to call for an alternative to the Royal Family, saying that "we can because it's a democracy".

"I know the monarch is not a political leader, but he is our leader, and we need to bow our knee to him.

He met the Queen throughout his career, including at Buckingham Palace where he said he spoke to her "and the corgis of course".

Humphrys, who presented the Nine O'Clock News, the Today programme and Mastermind throughout a decades-long career with the corporation, said he took the opportunity to ask her for an interview.

"When I'd finished, she looked up at me and said just one word 'no' and I thought I could build on that," he said.
body.zh: 资深广播员约翰·汉弗莱斯在发布一部探索王室角色的纪录片时表示，英国人民应该“能够选择我们的领导人”。 几十年来，汉弗莱斯一直是 BBC 最著名的面孔之一，他正在制作第四频道的一部新纪录片，名为《皇家队：该出发了？》 这位出生于卡迪夫的主持人在接受英国广播公司威尔士广播电台早餐节目采访时表示，他在很多方面“钦佩”国王查理三世，但表示这是一个“选择的问题”。 在纪录片中，汉弗莱斯与君主制的批评者和支持者进行了交谈，并阐述了选举总统作为国家元首的理由。 他回忆起在他长大的时候看到已故女王伊丽莎白三世访问卡迪夫，看着她被开车沿着纽波特路行驶。 “我父亲没有出席，他说他永远不会向任何人屈服。我想这对我产生了影响，”他说。 汉弗莱斯问为什么呼吁替代王室被视为禁忌，他说“我们可以，因为这是民主国家”。 “我知道君主不是政治领袖，但他是我们的领袖，我们需要向他屈服。 他在整个职业生涯中都见过女王，包括在白金汉宫，他说他在那里与她“当然还有柯基犬”交谈过。 汉弗莱斯在该公司长达数十年的职业生涯中一直主持《九点钟新闻》、《今日节目》和《Mastermind》，他说他借此机会邀请她接受采访。 “当我说完后，她抬头看着我，只说了一个字‘不’，我想我可以在此基础上再接再厉，”他说。

reflection.en: John Humphrys' documentary prompts a timely question about the nature of leadership and the right of citizens to choose their heads of state. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the oppressor him who suffers violence.' This verse reminds us that leadership, whether inherited or elected, carries a profound...
reflection.zh: 约翰·汉弗莱斯的纪录片提出了一个关于领导力本质和公民选择国家元首权利的及时问题。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这节经文提醒我们，无论是世袭还是民选的领导，都肩负着公正服务人民的重大责任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
title.zh: 智利电影导演帕特里西奥·古兹曼去世，享年85岁

summary.en: Patricio Guzmán, a filmmaker celebrated for his unflinching yet poetic documentaries that explored the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile and its subsequent social and political turmoil, has died at the age of 85. He passed away in Paris following cardiorespiratory arrest. Guzmán's work consistently focused on the...
summary.zh: 帕特里西奥·古兹曼（Patricio Guzmán）是一位电影制作人，他以其毫不留情却又富有诗意的纪录片而闻名国际，这些影片探讨了皮诺切特政权在智利及其后续社会政治动荡的影响。他于周二在巴黎因心肺骤停去世，享年85岁。古兹曼的职业生涯主要关注1973年奥古斯托·皮诺切特政变对萨尔瓦多·阿连德总统及其民选政府造成的破坏。

body.en: Passionate documentary maker won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85. According to Chilean news outlet Emol , Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest. Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president. He later told the Guardian : “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator. It has remained with me for ever. I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist. Neither am I a politician. I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 帕特里西奥·古兹曼是一位充满激情的纪录片制作人，他以毫不留情但富有诗意的电影探讨了皮诺切特政权对智利的影响，赢得了国际赞誉。帕特里西奥·古兹曼曾在《智利之战》和《怀念光明》等影片中记录了智利 1970 年代血腥的政治冲突以及随后的社会和政治动乱，现已去世，享年 85 岁。据智利新闻媒体《Emol》报道，古兹曼于周二在巴黎因心肺衰竭去世。逮捕。古兹曼整个职业生涯的主要关注点是 1973 年奥古斯托·皮诺切特 (Augusto Pinochet) 针对智利民选总统萨尔瓦多·阿连德 (Salvador Allende) 发起的政变所引发的屠杀。他后来告诉《卫报》：“我是一名电影制作人，对独裁者的行事方式有着深刻的印象。它永远伴随着我。我不能把它抛在身后。”然而，他拒绝承认自己是一名激进分子、政治电影制片人，并补充道：“我不是社会学家。我也不是政治家。我制作的电影具有隐喻性和诗意；我通过自己个人的观看方式来解释现实。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: For decades, Patricio Guzmán bore witness to the deep wounds inflicted by political violence in Chile, chronicling the suffering and turmoil with unflinching honesty. His films, like 'The Battle of Chile,' served as a powerful testament to the human cost of oppression and upheaval. Through his work, he sought to bring understanding and perhaps a measure of...
reflection.zh: 数十年来，帕特里西奥·古兹曼见证了智利政治暴力造成的深刻创伤，并以毫不动摇的诚实记录了苦难和动荡。《智利之战》等影片有力地证明了压迫和动荡对人类造成的代价。通过他的作品，他试图为仍在努力应对过去创伤的国家带来理解，或许还有一丝治愈，这呼应了神治愈心碎之人的应许。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Israeli minister threatens to strip Israeli film-makers of citizenship over Gaza documentary NAZA
title.zh: 以色列部长威胁取消加沙纪录片制作人的公民身份

summary.en: Israel's culture minister, Miki Zohar, has called for the citizenship of Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor to be revoked. He accused them of "treason against the state" for their documentary 'NAZA,' which exposes the Israeli intelligence service's acronym for expected civilian casualties in Gaza...
summary.zh: 以色列文化部长米基·佐哈尔呼吁取消奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和蕾切尔·索尔的公民身份。他指责他们制作的纪录片《NAZA》犯有“叛国罪”，该片揭露了以色列情报部门用于表示加沙空袭中预期平民伤亡的缩略语。这部电影强调了以色列军事行动对平民造成的毁灭性影响。

body.en: Miki Zohar accuses Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor of ‘treason against the state’ ‘They know the house they are bombing is full of children’: NAZA’s directors on their devastating film about Israeli intelligence Israel’s culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli directors of NAZA , a documentary about the country’s mass killing of civilians in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship, accusing them of “treason against the state”. NAZA, which was produced by the Guardian, is named for an acronym used by Israel’s intelligence service to indicate how many civilians it expects to die in an airstrike on Gaza. Continue reading...
body.zh: 米基·佐哈尔指责奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔“背叛国家”“他们知道他们轰炸的房子里都是孩子”：NAZA 的导演在拍摄有关以色列情报的毁灭性电影时以色列文化部长呼吁剥夺奥斯卡获奖导演 NAZA 的以色列国籍，这是一部关于该国在加沙大规模屠杀平民的纪录片，指责他们“背叛国家”。 NAZA 由《卫报》制作，以以色列情报部门使用的缩写词命名，用于表示预计在加沙空袭中将有多少平民死亡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story presents a stark conflict between artistic expression and state power. When a government official threatens to revoke citizenship for a film that documents civilian suffering, it raises questions about accountability and the role of art in confronting difficult truths. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness" and protect...
reflection.zh: 这个故事呈现了艺术表达与国家权力之间尖锐的冲突。当一位政府官员威胁要取消一部记录平民苦难的电影制作人的公民身份时，就引发了关于问责制和艺术在面对艰难真相中的作用的问题。耶利米书 22:3 呼吁领导人“施行公平和公义”，保护弱者，这是一个可以衡量此类行为的标准。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: ‘Who do you really believe?’: the true crime fans who became a part of the story
title.zh: “你到底相信谁？”：成为故事一部分的真实犯罪迷

summary.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that the woman accused of murder is innocent. A man and a woman were murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly fell on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family...
summary.zh: 在HBO引人入胜的新纪录片系列《一个杀人故事》中，一对热心的夫妇坚信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。2002年的一天晚上，一男一女在堪萨斯州托皮卡家中被谋杀。嫌疑很快落在了受害男子的前妻 Dana Chandler...

body.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that woman accused of murder is innocent A man and a woman are murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly falls on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family and forensic evidence painting her as the jealous type. But the county prosecutor at the time declines to pursue charges in large part because nothing places Chandler at the scene of the crime. It’s only after a politically motivated prosecutor is appointed and CBS’s 48 Hours airs a 2009 report rehashing the case that Chandler is arrested on two counts of premeditated first-degree murder in 2011 and condemned to consecutive life sentences the following year. No doubt: the story is hot copy. And more than likely, Chandler’s conviction marks the conclusion if a husband-and-wife team of true crime enthusiasts hadn’t become convinced that the real killer was still walking free. “There’s a lot of questions that remain,” says film-maker Matthew Galkin. “But when you start to unpack the crime itself, there’s a lot of hoops to jump through and a very high bar to clear in order for her to have pulled this off.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 HBO 扣人心弦的新纪录片《杀手故事》中，一对斗志昂扬的夫妇确信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。 2002 年，一名男子和一名女子在黑暗的掩护下，在堪萨斯州托皮卡的卧室里被冷血谋杀。嫌疑人很快就落到了该男子的前妻达纳·钱德勒的身上，家人和法医证据都将她描绘成嫉妒型的人。但当时的县检察官拒绝提出指控，很大程度上是因为没有任何证据显示钱德勒在犯罪现场。直到任命了一位出于政治动机的检察官，并且哥伦比亚广播公司的 48 小时频道播出了 2009 年的报道，重述了此案之后，钱德勒才于 2011 年因两项预谋一级谋杀罪被捕，并在次年被连续判处无期徒刑。毫无疑问：这个故事是热门副本。如果一对真正的犯罪爱好者组成的夫妻团队没有相信真正的凶手仍然逍遥法外，那么钱德勒的定罪很可能标志着一个结论。 “还有很多问题没有解决，”电影制片人马修·加尔金说。 “但是，当你开始揭开犯罪本身的真相时，为了让她成功完成这件事，有很多障碍需要跨越，还有很高的门槛需要克服。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary series delves into the complexities of true crime, where a couple's conviction of innocence challenges the initial accusations. It reminds us of the importance of seeking truth and not settling for the first or loudest narrative. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this, stating that 'The first person to speak in a lawsuit seems right, until someone...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片系列深入探讨了真实犯罪的复杂性，其中一对夫妇坚信某女子无辜，这挑战了最初的指控。它提醒我们寻求真相的重要性，不要满足于第一个或最响亮的声音。箴言18:17对此有所阐述，‘在讼事上先开口的，似乎都有理；但邻 Comes，就审问他。’

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Musk review – epic study of the world’s richest and most banal man
title.zh: 马斯克评论——关于世界上最富有但又最平庸的男人的史诗研究

summary.en: Venice Film Festival: Alex Gibney's absorbing documentary, 'Elon is a Nuke,' interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire's father, and even a CG avatar. Ashley St Clair, a former conservative influencer and Musk's ex-girlfriend, is featured as an 'expert witness' in this four-hour study of the South...
summary.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼的引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是一枚核弹》采访了前同事、妻子、这位万亿富翁的父亲，甚至还有一个电脑生成化身。阿什莉·圣克莱尔（Ashley St...

body.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary ‘Elon is a nuke.” The speaker is Ashley St Clair, a former conservative Maga influencer and one of Elon Musk’s former girlfriends-slash-baby mommas. She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour epic study of the world’s richest and dullest man: the overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz visionary and Trump courtier who owns Tesla cars, SpaceX rocket ships, Starlink satellites on which nation states’ military capabilities are increasingly reliant, X (formerly Twitter) which shapes the collective incel id of billions and GrokAI whose vast server farms daily guzzle oceans of precious water. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼在这部引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是核武器》中采访了他的前同事、妻子、亿万富翁的父亲和 CG 头像。演讲者是阿什利·圣克莱尔 (Ashley St Clair)，她是一位前保守派 Maga 影响者，也是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的前女友、斜线婴儿妈妈之一。在亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）对世界上最富有和最愚钝的人的长达四个小时的史诗般的研究中，她是一位引人入胜的专家证人：出生于南非的亿万富翁，是一个过于自大、脾气暴躁的亿万富豪、冒牌的梦想家和特朗普的朝臣，拥有特斯拉汽车、SpaceX火箭飞船、民族国家军事能力越来越依赖的星链卫星、塑造了数十亿集体非自愿群体的X（以前的推特）和每天都有庞大服务器群的GrokAI吞噬海洋宝贵的水资源。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary probes the immense power and influence of Elon Musk, a figure who wields vast technological control. The narrative describes him as an 'ersatz visionary,' suggesting a disconnect between his ambition and true wisdom. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition and technological prowess sought to reach the heavens,...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片深入探讨了埃隆·马斯克——这位拥有巨大技术控制权的人物——的巨大权力和影响力。叙述将他描述为一位“伪造的远见者”，暗示了他的野心与真正的智慧之间存在脱节。这让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的野心和技术实力试图触及天堂，最终导致了混乱和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Better Go Mad in the Wild review – boozing, bantering hermits impart their spiritual wisdom
title.zh: 深入荒野：在狂野中走向疯狂评论——酗酒、闲聊的隐士传授他们的精神智慧

summary.en: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary. Narrated by a slaughtered bull, this extraordinary film charts the daily life of a pair of Czech twins who are themselves far off conventional routes....
summary.zh: 导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找一对过着孤立生活、充满奇特智慧的兄弟，这是一部超现实的纪录片。这部由一头被屠宰的公牛旁白的非凡电影，记录了一对捷克双胞胎兄弟的日常生活，他们自己也早已偏离了常规的道路。弗兰蒂谢克和奥德烈·克利希克正住在舒马瓦山脉的一间小屋里，他们正慢慢地走向疯狂——或者说，接近了启迪。

body.en: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary Narrated by a slaughtered bull, this extraordinary film takes the less-travelled path in charting the daily life of a pair of Czech twins a long way off conventional routes themselves. František and Ondřej Klišík are slowly going mad – or maybe closing in on enlightenment – in a cabin in the Šumava mountains and, extrapolating a short story about the brothers by Aleš Palán, director Miro Remo succumbs productively to the prevailing cabin fever – not only egging these longbeards on in their squabbling and loopy philosophising, but pitching in with his own fabulism and surrealism. Closing on 60, “Franta” and “Ondra” still farm their smallholding with the help of Nandy, a mutinous bull ill-chosen as a draught animal. In their downtime, they booze, banter and bicker, lament their lack of prospects with the fairer sex, and blow off steam in epic arm-wrestling bouts. Despite an arm lost to a sawmill accident, it’s Franta who’s usually the victor; he is also possessed by a quixotic streak absent in his bluff sibling. Letting loose streams of poetry into the air like bunting, wishing “joy to all conscious beings”, he is also constructing his own Da Vinci-style perpetual flying machine. “Your aversion to my perpetuum is a little annoying,” he informs the exasperated Ondra. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在这部超现实的纪录片中，导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找充满堂吉诃德式智慧的两兄弟过着与世隔绝的生活。这部非凡的影片由一头被宰杀的公牛讲述，采取了一条人迹罕至的道路，描绘了一对捷克双胞胎的日常生活，远离传统路线。弗兰蒂谢克和昂德热·克利希克在苏马瓦山的一间小屋里慢慢发疯——或者可能接近启蒙，导演米罗·雷莫根据阿莱什·帕兰写的关于兄弟俩的短篇小说，有效地屈服于盛行的小屋热——不仅怂恿这些长胡子的人争吵和疯狂的哲学思考，还用自己的寓言和超现实主义。截至 60 日，“Franta”和“Ondra”仍在南迪（Nandy）的帮助下耕种他们的小农场，南迪是一头叛变的公牛，被错误地选为役畜。在闲暇时间，她们会喝酒、开玩笑、争吵，哀叹自己与异性交往的前景不佳，并在史诗般的扳手腕比赛中发泄情绪。尽管弗兰塔在锯木厂事故中失去了一条手臂，但通常胜利者都是弗兰塔。他还具有他那直率的兄弟所没有的不切实际的性格。他像彩旗一样将诗意的溪流抛向空中，祝愿“所有有意识的生物都快乐”，他也在建造自己的达芬奇式永久飞行器。 “你对我的永恒的厌恶有点烦人，”他告诉愤怒的昂德拉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary explores the fine line between profound isolation and spiritual insight, as two brothers grapple with their existence in the Czech wilderness. The film invites contemplation on what it means to seek wisdom, even when that path leads to the fringes of sanity. It reminds us that the search for meaning can be a deeply personal and sometimes...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了深刻的孤立与精神洞见之间的界限，讲述了两兄弟在捷克荒野中挣扎求生的故事。这部电影引人深思，探讨了寻求智慧的意义，即使这条道路会将人引向疯狂的边缘。它提醒我们，对意义的追寻可能是一段极其个人化且有时艰辛的旅程，触及了伴随如此深刻内省而来的破碎心灵。

verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: James McNeill Whistler review – painter’s work shines through attention-grabbing life story
title.zh: 詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒评论——画家作品在引人入胜的人生故事中闪耀

summary.en: The latest Exhibition on Screen documentary balances the famous scandals of James McNeill Whistler with the subtle brilliance of his art, timed to coincide with Tate Britain’s exhibition.
summary.zh: 最新的“展览 على الشاشة”纪录片很好地平衡了詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒的著名丑闻与他艺术的微妙才华，该片与泰特不列颠的展览同期上映。

body.en: The latest Exhibition on Screen documentary does a good job balancing the famous scandals with the subtle brilliance of his art Timed to coincide with Tate Britain’s impressive gallery show – which closes at the end of September, so you haven’t long if you’ve missed it so far – this latest from the Exhibition on Screen strand does a fine job in outlining the ins and outs, and ups and downs of this still somewhat divisive artist who, Whistler’s Mother notwithstanding, is still probably most famous for winning a farthing in damages in his “flinging a pot of paint” libel action against John Ruskin. The film assembles the customary lineup of notables including the Tate’s Carol Jacobi, critic Rachel Campbell-Johnston and art historian Stephen Calloway, the latter of whom’s dandyish attire and Colonel Sanders goatee suggests he has very much bought into the Whistler aesthetic. In fact, as all the interviewees are keen to point out, Whistler’s self-constructed persona, always with an eye to making a splash, is as significant an element of his artistic presence as the art itself – even if, as I can’t be alone in thinking, there’s something fundamentally irritating about his southern-genteel attudinising even at a century and a half’s distance. Be that as it may, the film gets to grips with Whistler’s instinctive brilliance as an artist, his natural flair for boundary-pushing and forward-thinking idealism. The big life episodes – his arrival in London, painting his mother, the brouhaha over the Peacock Room , the court case and subsequent bankruptcy – are recounted, but there is impressive detail on the actual art: from the dynamics behind his brooding Wapping picture to the temper tantrums (not his) that made Harmony in Grey and Green, his portrait of the eight-year-old Cicely Alexander so distinctive. And while Whistler’s dealings with the women in his life wouldn’t exactly pass modern-era scrutiny, his pictures of them are genuinely brilliant, with especial attention given to a wonderfully tender sketch of his wife Beatrix , terminally ill in a hotel bedroom. Continue reading...
body.zh: 最新的银幕展览纪录片很好地平衡了著名的丑闻和他艺术的微妙光彩，恰逢泰特英国美术馆令人印象深刻的画廊展览——该展览将于九月底结束，所以如果你到目前为止已经错过了它，那么你也不会太久——这部银幕展览的最新纪录片很好地概述了这位仍然有些分裂的艺术家的来龙去脉和起起落落，尽管惠斯勒的母亲，他可能仍然是最著名的艺术家他在针对约翰·罗斯金的“泼一盆油漆”诽谤诉讼中赢得了一分钱的赔偿金。这部电影汇集了传统的名人阵容，包括泰特美术馆的卡罗尔·雅各比、评论家雷切尔·坎贝尔-约翰斯顿和艺术史学家斯蒂芬·卡洛韦，后者的花哨服装和桑德斯上校的山羊胡子表明他非常接受惠斯勒的审美。事实上，正如所有受访者都热衷指出的那样，惠斯勒自我塑造的形象，总是着眼于引起轰动，与艺术本身一样是他艺术存在的重要元素——尽管，正如我不能独自思考的那样，即使在一个半世纪的距离之外，他的南方文雅态度从根本上令人恼火。尽管如此，这部电影还是展现了惠斯勒作为艺术家的本能才华、突破界限和前瞻性理想主义的天赋。书中讲述了他一生中的重大事件——抵达伦敦、为母亲画画、《孔雀屋》引起的骚动、法庭案件和随后的破产——但也有关于实际艺术的令人印象深刻的细节：从他沉思的沃平画背后的动态，到使《灰绿和谐》中的脾气暴躁（不是他的），他为八岁的西塞莉·亚历山大（Cicely Alexander）所作的肖像如此独特。虽然惠斯勒与他生活中的女性的相处方式并不能完全通过现代时代的审视，但他为她们拍摄的照片确实非常精彩，尤其是他在酒店卧室里身患绝症的妻子贝娅特丽克丝的温柔素描。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary explores the life and art of James McNeill Whistler, a painter known for both his scandals and his artistic achievements. It reminds us that even in fields often associated with personal drama, the dedication to craft and the pursuit of beauty can be seen as a form of service. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to do all our work heartily, as...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了画家詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒的生活与艺术，他以丑闻和艺术成就而闻名。它提醒我们，即使在那些常与个人戏剧相关的领域，对技艺的投入和对美的追求也可以被视为一种服务。歌罗西书3:23鼓励我们凡事甘心，如同为主而做，在我们的事业中找到尊严和目标，无论它们是宏大的还是微妙的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Israeli minister threatens to revoke filmmakers' citizenship over Gaza documentary
title.zh: 以色列部长威胁取消加沙纪录片制作人公民身份

summary.en: Israel's culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli co-directors of 'Naza,' a documentary accusing the Israeli army of mass civilian killings in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship, labeling their work as 'treason against the state.' The film utilizes AI-powered targeting systems information and...
summary.zh: 以色列文化部长呼吁剥夺奥斯卡获奖影片《纳扎》的以色列联合导演的公民身份。该纪录片指控以色列军队在加沙犯下大规模平民杀戮罪行，部长称其为“叛国”。影片使用了人工智能驱动的瞄准系统信息，并采访了未透露身份的以色列军方和情报官员。

body.en:
Israel's culture minister has called for the Oscar-winning Israeli co-directors of Naza, a documentary that accuses the Israeli army of mass civilian killings in Gaza, to be stripped of their citizenship over "treason against the state".

Named for the Hebrew military acronym for collateral damage, the film speaks to 24 unidentified Israeli military and intelligence officers who outlined the AI-powered targeting systems used by the Israeli army to bombard Gaza in the war triggered by the Hamas-led attack on 7 October 2023.

Since then, more than 73,000 Palestinians, including more than 20,000 children, have been killed in the campaign by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry, figures considered reliable by the UN. About 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken hostage during the Hamas attack.

Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor say their 80-minute documentary "details the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza" during the war, according to its official synopsis. One of the people interviewed says there was the approval for an attack to kill 500 people for "one human target", an allegation the IDF said was "completely false".

In a post on X, Culture Minister Miki Zohar said he had asked the authorities "to investigate how the materials were obtained, who is behind them, and whether in the process of obtaining or publishing them, actions were taken that amount to aiding the enemy during wartime".

In a letter addressed to Israel's Interior Ministry, he said: "The claims presented in the film are false and distorted, and I categorically reject the attempt to portray IDF soldiers and the State of Israel as perpetrators of intentional crimes." Zohar mentioned the country's Citizenship Law, saying it "allows for the revocation of citizenship due to a 'breach of allegiance to the State of Israel'". The measure, however, has rarely been applied.

There has been no immediate reaction from Abraham and Szor. The filmmakers won an Oscar last year for No Other Land, a documentary about violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.

Naza premiered last Thursday at the Venice Film Festival, where it received a 25-minute standing ovation, but has not yet been made available to the wider public. It won a special jury prize at the festival. Speaking then, Abraham said the reporting for the film, which was produced by the UK's Guardian newspaper, had been "rigorous" and that efforts to discredit it were "attempts to not face reality".

"It's a war that has principally been killing civilians. And I think our film is showing that this is not some mistake. It's not an accident. It's something very, very systemic. And this should have been apparent to everyone, I...
body.zh: 以色列文化部长呼吁以“叛国罪”为由，剥夺奥斯卡奖得主、纪录片《纳扎》的以色列联合导演的国籍，该纪录片指责以色列军队在加沙大规模屠杀平民。 该影片以希伯来语军事缩写“附带损害”的缩写命名，讲述了 24 名身份不明的以色列军方和情报官员的故事，他们概述了以色列军队在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击引发的战争中轰炸加沙的人工智能瞄准系统。 据哈马斯管理的加沙卫生部称，自那时起，已有超过 73,000 名巴勒斯坦人在以色列国防军 (IDF) 的行动中丧生，其中包括 20,000 多名儿童，联合国认为这一数字是可靠的。哈马斯袭击造成约 1,200 人死亡，251 人被扣为人质。 根据官方简介，尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔表示，他们的 80 分钟纪录片“详细介绍了战争期间以色列在加沙有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民的幕后系统”。一名接受采访的人士表示，针对“一个人类目标”发动一次造成 500 人死亡的袭击已获得批准，但以色列国防军称这一指控“完全错误”。 文化部长米基·佐哈尔(Miki Zohar)在X上发帖称，他已要求当局“调查这些材料是如何获得的、谁是幕后黑手，以及在获得或发布这些材料的过程中是否采取了相当于战时援敌的行动”。 他在写给以色列内政部的一封信中表示：“影片中的说法是虚假和扭曲的，我坚决反对将以色列国防军士兵和以色列国描绘成故意犯罪的肇事者的企图。”佐哈尔提到了该国的公民法，称该法“允许因‘违反对以色列国的效忠’而撤销公民身份”。然而，这项措施很少得到应用。 亚伯拉罕和索尔没有立即做出反应。去年，电影制片人凭借《No Other Land》获得了奥斯卡奖，该纪录片讲述了犹太定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为。 《娜扎》上周四在威尼斯电影节上首映，获得了 25 分钟的起立鼓掌，但尚未向更广泛的公众开放。它在电影节上获得了评审团特别奖。亚伯拉罕当时表示，这部由英国《卫报》制作的电影的报道是“严谨的”，抹黑影片的努力是“试图不面对现实”。 “这是一场主要杀害平民的战争。我认为我们的电影表明这不是一个错误。这不是一次意外。这是非常非常系统性的事情。这对每个人来说都应该是显而易见的，我......

reflection.en: The filmmakers behind 'Naza' face severe repercussions for their work, which gives voice to accusations of mass civilian killings in Gaza. Their situation underscores the courage required to speak truth to power, especially when it involves challenging narratives about military actions. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to 'speak up for all the voiceless, and defend...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《纳扎》的制作人因其揭露加沙大规模平民杀戮指控的工作而面临严厉报复。他们的处境凸显了在挑战军事行动叙事时，向权力说真话所需的勇气。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为所有不能说话的人说话，为所有孤苦无依的人伸张正义”。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
